ev:1-absolute-luck:a-bribe-for-the-admir.html:
The officer weighs the purses, finds that your contraband has become remarkably hard to see, and turns his back. The cutter comes about, and every marine aboard crowds round to watch him count. Nobody is watching the stern, or the boarding net still trailing from it.

Choose one
  • Sail on, while they're busy counting. GO TO another day at sea.
  • Climb the net, and take them from behind. GO TO over the stern.

ev:1-absolute-luck:a-gale-for-the-admira.html: A word, a gesture, and the wind turns on the cutter. Its sails bang aback, its bow swings away, and by the time its crew have it under control, your raft is a speck to leeward, and so is the officer's plumed helmet, bobbing on the swell. Everyone gains 3 EXP. GO TO another day at sea.

ev:1-absolute-luck:a-warm-welcome.title: A Warm Welcome
ev:1-absolute-luck:a-warm-welcome.html:
They come in a glowing tide, clicking, and the sand smokes wherever they pass. Under it, something round and pulsing keeps making more.

A Warm Welcome
Enemy HP: 10 per player, or 7 if you found the nest
Enemy
5×Emberskitter (#25)
Emberskitter Sack (#26)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Travel item and 4 gold, from the bones of the last traveler.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:after-the-singer.html: You find her by the sound: a robed figure kneeling over an open grave, too lost in her song to see you coming. Behind you, the dead close ranks. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Swan Song.

ev:1-absolute-luck:back-to-the-colours.html: They don't trust you at first. Then the fire is lit, and one by one they kneel beside you and talk: a captain who sold their rations, a battle they ran from, the friends they left on the field. You hear them all, and pray with each of them, and something they lost comes back into their faces. By midnight they're arguing about who gets to tell the general they're back. At dawn they march off towards the war, their sergeant drilling them all the way, and you with them for the first mile. When you part, he presses a bundle wrapped in sacking into your hands. “Spare kit,” he says. “Somebody else's. They won't be needing it.” Everyone gains 3 EXP. You gain 1x random Common Weapon. STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:1-absolute-luck:deserts.html:
The sand stays warm long after sunset. Then it gets warmer. Then, all around you, it begins to glow, and to click, and to move: spiders the size of your fist, glowing like coals, boiling up out of the dunes and scuttling straight for you. Somewhere under your feet, something pulses like a heart. Beside you lie a traveler's bleached bones.

Choose one
  • (Someone adds an Exhaustion to their deck) Dig for the pulsing thing under the sand. GO TO the nest found.
  • Stand and fight. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

ev:1-absolute-luck:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:1-absolute-luck:mountains.html: The mouth of a cave shelters a lit campfire undisturbed by the buffeting wind, casting its lazy light over a pile of abandoned supplies. Whoever left them left in a hurry. You gain 2x random Common item. As you shoulder the pack, the fire gutters, and the frost on the rocks begins to creep. GO TO Rime and Punishment.

ev:1-absolute-luck:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:1-absolute-luck:oceans.html:
A cutter flying the royal colours runs down on your raft, and an officer in a plumed helmet leans over the rail. “By order of the Admiralty, the Shackled are barred from these waters. You'll be towed ashore, and your contraband confiscated.” He looks over your belongings. All of them, it seems, are contraband.

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Bribe the officer. GO TO a bribe for the Admiralty.
  • Refuse. GO TO the officer sighs.
  • (If there is a Blue character in your party) Call up a gale, and blow them off. GO TO a gale for the Admiralty.

links.clause: If there is a Blue character in your party) Call up a gale

ev:1-absolute-luck:over-the-stern.html: You come over the rail without a sound. The officer is still counting, and doesn't look up until you're standing on his deck. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:1-absolute-luck:pale-figures-rise.html:
You watch in horror as several pale figures rise around you, eyes alight with the dark embers of undeath. As their skeletal bodies take shape, they waste no time readying their rusted weapons.

Somewhere deeper in the mist, someone is singing them up, a thin and tuneless keening.

Choose one
  • Plunge into the mist after the singer, through the dead. GO TO after the singer.
  • Put your back to an old oak, and let them come to you. GO TO Bad to the Bone.

ev:1-absolute-luck:plains.title: Plains
ev:1-absolute-luck:plains.html:
You travel at night, keeping a safe distance from the main roads. The silence is only broken by the rustling of grass and the chirp of an army of crickets, cicadas, the occasional toad, and countless other nightly critters. Then, from a hollow ahead, the faint friction of steel against steel.

Deserters, half a dozen of them in army mail, sit round a strongbox in the hollow without a fire, in disciplined silence. Up on the ridge, two of them mind the horses.

Choose one
  • Go for the strongbox. GO TO Pay Day.
  • Go for the horses, and ride off before the rest are in the saddle. GO TO Horse Thieves.
  • (If there is a Gold character in your party) Walk down with your hands open, and offer to hear their confessions. They look like they need it. GO TO back to the colours.

links.clause: If there is a Gold character in your party) Walk down with your hands open

ev:1-absolute-luck:repel-boarders.title: Repel Boarders
ev:1-absolute-luck:repel-boarders.html:
Repel Boarders
Enemy HP: 11 + 6 per player
Enemy
Royal Guard (#30)
Bandit (#1)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you bribed the officer, take back your 4 gold.
  • 1x random Common Armor and 2 gold, off the marines.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • Each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the cutter is yours. If you lost, the cutter tows you to the nearest shore, and cuts you loose in the surf: move to the nearest land location. GO TO successful landing.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-cutter-is-yours.html: The officer goes over the side last, plume and all, and his marines fish him out of the water. You cut your raft loose and let it drift away astern. You have a ship, and it flies the royal colours. GO TO A Ship of Your Own.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-nest-found.html: You drive your blade into the sand where it beats hardest, and a whole clutch dies before it hatches. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-officer-sighs.html: The officer sighs, as if you'd spilled something on his deck, and waves his marines over the rail, with a press-ganged deckhand shoved along behind them. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:1-absolute-luck:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:1-absolute-luck:woodlands.html: Mist pools between the trees, and the birds fall silent all at once. Under the moss at your feet, something stirs. GO TO pale figures rise.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-closer-loo.html: You lean over with the bottle, and the sea leans up to meet you. You gain 1x random Uncommon Potion. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Dead Calm.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-cub-for-a-.html: The cub squeals and kicks, and its mother comes out of the bracken and stops dead, swaying, not daring to strike. You let it go when you're ready, and not before, and the Shackle tightens. +1 curse. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:brass-tacks.title: Brass Tacks
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:brass-tacks.html:
The sand pours off the brass as it stands, and stands, until its head scrapes the roof of the cave. Smaller brass things whir up out of the sand after it, crackling.

Brass Tacks
Enemy HP: 4 + 11 per player
Enemy
Lodestone Warden (#36)
Arc Drone (#44)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you listened to the hermit or dug with him: 1x random Uncommon Travel item, wrapped in goatskin, his gift.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:dead-calm.title: Dead Calm
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:dead-calm.html:
The skin heaves, gathers itself into lumps, and the lumps climb aboard.

Dead Calm
Enemy HP: 8 + 10 per player
Enemy
Slime (#33)
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the skin breaks up, and the wind comes back: you may move to a connected Ocean sector. Win or lose, GO TO another day at sea.

links.clause: If you won

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:deserts.html:
A thread of smoke leads you to a cave above the dunes, where a hermit lives with a goat and a great many opinions. Behind him, at the back of the cave, a brass hand the size of a cart sticks up out of the sand. He hangs his washing on it, and he keeps something buried under it, wrapped in goatskin.

Choose one
  • Sit down, and listen to him. GO TO the hermit's prophecy.
  • Help him dig out whatever's under the hand. GO TO dug out.
  • (+1 curse) Take whatever he's buried, and leave him to the goat. GO TO the hermit robbed.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:dug-out.html: You dig fast, and you've cleared the hand, the arm and most of a shoulder before anything under the sand thinks to stop you. Half of it is still buried when it wakes, but you've dug up more than the giant. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round, and the fight has one Arc Drone more. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:in-hot-water.title: In Hot Water
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:in-hot-water.html:
It rises out of the pool, and keeps rising. The steam freezes as it pours off its fur, and the bones of the other bathers get up out of the snow to join it.

In Hot Water
Enemy HP: 8 + 10 per player
Enemy
Raised Bones (#3)
Ice Troll (#7)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Armor, from what the bathers wore.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, the pools are yours: you may rest here now, at the cost of 1 curse. STOP READING. If you lost, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:mountains.html:
Steam rises from a ring of pools high on the mountain, warm as a bath and smelling faintly of eggs. Something large and white is sitting in the biggest one, eyes closed, humming. Around the pools, the snow is littered with the bones of other bathers, and at the bottom of the clearest pool, their packs and purses.

Choose one
  • Creep up while it soaks, and strike while the heat has it slow. GO TO soaked through.
  • Hold your breath, and dive for the bathers' things. GO TO the bathers' things.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:oceans.html:
The wind begins to falter. Gusts come further and further apart, and the sail sags between them like washing on a still day. By noon the sea is flat as glass, and by afternoon it has grown a skin, faintly green, that wrinkles when you poke it, and doesn't stop wrinkling when you stop.

Choose one
  • Skim some of the skin into a bottle while it's thin. Any alchemist would pay for it. GO TO a closer look.
  • Wait for it, oars raised. GO TO Dead Calm.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:out-of-the-b.title: Out of the Breach
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:out-of-the-b.html:
The breach tears wider, and whatever is on the other side comes pouring through: embers first, then legs, dozens and dozens of legs, and then the thing they belong to.

Out of the Breach
Enemy HP: 12 + 11 per player
Enemy
Ember Matriarch (#27)
4×Emberskitter (#25)
Outcome
Victory
  • The breach closes behind the last of them.
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon, left behind in the ashes.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:plains.title: Plains
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:plains.html:
In the middle of a burned field, the air has split open like old canvas: a breach as tall as a door, with a red glow far below. A grey, long-fingered hand in a rusted iron cuff reaches out of it and beckons to you. A voice speaks inside your head, reasonable and a little bored. “You'll be mine in the end anyway. Why not sell early, while the price is good?” Further down, something glowing like embers climbs towards the light on far too many legs.

Choose one
  • (If there is a Gold character in your party) Pray to Adrai'lalth to close the breach. GO TO the breach narrows.
  • (+2 curse) Take the hand, and sell. GO TO the sale.
  • Draw your weapons, and wait at the breach for whatever climbs out. GO TO Out of the Breach.

links.clause: If there is a Gold character in your party) Pray to Adrai'lalth to close the breach

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:soaked-throu.html: It's been soaking for hours, and the heat has got right into it. It comes out of the water slow, and steaming. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO In Hot Water.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:something-fo.html: The cubs fall on the meat, and the big bears keep looking back at them, slow to leave them. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-bathers-.html: You come up gasping, with your arms full of sodden gear, and the yeti's nose an inch from yours. You gain 1x random Common Armor and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO In Hot Water.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-breach-n.html: The light of your prayer pours into the gap like water into a crack, and the edges begin to knit. Not fast enough to stop everything. Fast enough to shut out the last of the brood. The fight has one Emberskitter fewer. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hermit-r.html: You push the old man aside, and he sits down hard next to his goat, and for the first time in twenty years, he stops talking. You dig the bundle out from under the hand, and his savings with it, and something under the hand digs back. You gain 7 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hermit-s.html: He talks all night: about the old kings, and the brass men they built to guard their tombs, and the one he's been sitting on for twenty years. At dawn he stops, pleased that someone finally knows, and takes up his spade. “Best you see it with your own eyes,” he says, and he's cleared the wrist before you can stop him. The fingers twitch. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-sale.html: The hand is warm, and grips yours like an old friend's. The voice names a price you hear with something other than your ears, and when you look down, the goods are in your hands, and something is missing from inside you. The voice keeps its word, to the letter. Then the hand lets go, and the breach closes on whatever was climbing up behind it. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:woodlands.html:
Two bear cubs tumble out of the bracken, see you, and squeak. Somewhere behind them, something much bigger stops eating.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Beast Meat) Toss the cubs your meat. GO TO something for the cubs.
  • Grab a cub, and hold it up between you and whatever's coming. GO TO a cub for a shield.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:deserts.html:
The sand forgives nothing. The days burn, the nights freeze, and the dunes move when you aren't looking. First, the desert takes its toll. Spin the weather vane and read the corresponding row. You may discard a Waterskin to take the row below it instead.

VaneThe desert's toll
SDiscard the top 3 adventure cards, and each player adds 2 Exhaustion to their combat deck. STOP READING.
SE, SWEach player adds an Exhaustion to their combat deck. STOP READING.
E, WA mirage. Go back where you came from, or, if you didn't move, spin the vane again and move to the adjacent location it aims at. STOP READING.
NE, NWDiscard the top 3 adventure cards. Continue reading.
NThe dunes let you pass. Continue reading.

You come through the sands, and the desert's stillness settles on you. Everyone gains 2 EXP.

Choose one
  • Sit among the dunes until you know exactly what you lack. Each player may look through their training deck for any card, buy it at its EXP cost, then shuffle the training deck. STOP READING.
  • Travel by night, and follow the stars. You may move to an adjacent location. STOP READING.
  • (On the coast) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:mountains.html:
The peaks don't care that you came. Every step up is paid for in breath, and the thin air leaves room for nothing but the next one.

Choose one
  • Drill on a high ledge until your legs shake. Everyone may train, looking at the top 6 cards of their training deck instead of 4. STOP READING.
  • Climb to the ridge and take in the view. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.
  • Bottle the snowmelt from a mountain stream. You gain a Waterskin (Common Travel #7). STOP READING.
  • (On the coast) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.
  • Pan a mountain stream for gold. Continue reading.

ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:panning-for-gold.html:
You crouch in the icy water until you can't feel your hands, swirling grit in a pan. Spin the weather vane:

VaneYou find
NA nugget the size of a thumbnail. You gain 8 gold.
NE, NWA few good flakes. You gain 4 gold.
E, WA pinch of dust. You gain 1 gold.
SE, SW, SGrit, and cold hands.

STOP READING.

ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:plains.title: Plains
ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:plains.html:
Grass runs to the edge of the world, and the wind combs it in long silver waves. There's nothing to hide behind out here, and nothing that needs to.

Choose one
  • Stop, and take in the view. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.
  • Spar in the long grass, with room to fall. Everyone may train. STOP READING.
  • (On the coast) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:sea-land-and-sky.title: Sea, Land and Sky
ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:sea-land-and-sky.html:
Every land has its ways, and those who travel it long enough learn them.

Read the section for your current terrain.

ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:100-sea-land-and-sky:woodlands.html:
The trees close overhead, and the light turns green and patient. The wood gives freely, to those who know where to look.

Choose one
  • Learn from the forest, one patient lesson at a time. Everyone looks at the top card of their training deck, and may buy it with a 3 EXP discount. STOP READING.
  • Climb to the treetops, and pick out the way ahead. Look at the top 2 cards of the adventure deck, and put any number of them on the bottom. STOP READING.
  • (On the coast) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:caught-red-han.title: Caught Red-Handed
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:caught-red-han.html:
The whole camp wakes at once, the way only soldiers can, with an officer bellowing orders before his boots are on.

Caught Red-Handed
Enemy HP: 6 + 11 per player
Enemy
Soldier (#22)
Inspiring Leader (#40)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, off the officer.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up: the camp charges for its trouble.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:deserts.html:
A mercenary camp sprawls around a well: hard men and women in iron and scarves, resting between contracts. Their quartermaster runs a stall from the back of a wagon, and beside it, in a ring of spears stuck in the sand, two of them are fighting for the fun of it. To her, business is business, Shackled or not, once they've seen you bleed.

Choose one
  • (Pay 3 gold) Buy the champion's last sparring partner a drink, and ask how he fights. GO TO you've seen his tricks.
  • Step straight into the ring. GO TO First Blood.
  • (+1 curse) Come back after dark, and help yourselves to the wagon. GO TO the pick of the wagon.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:fairy-ring.title: Fairy Ring
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:fairy-ring.html:
Every frog in the ring turns to face you at once. In the middle, a little grey figure in a toadstool cap stands up and claps, and more frogs blink into the ring.

Fairy Ring
Enemy HP: 12 + 10 per player
Enemy
Convoker (#15)
Warpfrog (#31)
Outcome
Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won and stepped in as you are, the ring knows you now, and carries you once: you and your allies may move to any location up to 3 locations away. STOP READING. If you won with your coat inside out, the ring goes dark, and the frogs with it. STOP READING. If you lost, you wake up outside the ring, some distance away: move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:inside-out.html: The frogs look at your coat, and then at each other, and don't seem to know what to make of you. Neither does the ring. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:mountains.html:
A monastery clings to the cliff above the path, all red roofs and prayer flags, and a bell rings as you climb towards it. At the gate, a monk in grey robes waits with a tray of tea, as if she'd been expecting you. Behind her, in the courtyard, brothers in bare feet are throwing each other across the flagstones, smiling. “Guests practise with us,” she says, “before they trade with us. It is how we pray.”

Choose one
  • Accept the tea, and practise with the brothers. GO TO Morning Practice.
  • Ask to practise with the master. GO TO the master steps in.
  • (+1 curse) Knock the tray aside, and rob the place. GO TO A Rude Awakening.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:oceans.html:
The sky is clear, the sea is calm, and it's raining frogs. They thump onto the raft by the dozen, croaking, and the ones you shove overboard turn up again a moment later, dripping, in the water barrel and down the back of your shirt.

Choose one
  • (Discard the top 3 adventure cards) Row out from under the cloud, and leave most of them behind. GO TO out from under the cloud.
  • Bail them overboard. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:out-from-under.html: You row until the frogs stop falling. The ones already aboard come with you, and they're not happy about it. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:plains.title: Plains
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:plains.html:
A brass tower stands in the middle of a parched wheat field, taller than any church, with a copper kite tethered to its crown. Under it, a woman in goggles and a leather apron is selling rain to the farmers by the barrel, at a steep price. The sky is black from one horizon to the other, and crackling, but not a drop falls anywhere but on the tower. The farmers say it hasn't rained anywhere else on the plain since it went up. The weather turns to Thunderstorm: put it on top of the weather pile.

Three brass things stand guard round the foot of the tower, and they've all turned to look at you.

Choose one
  • Cut the kite's tether, and let the storm go. GO TO the kite cut.
  • (If there is a Blue character in your party) Reach up into the storm, and draw its power into yourself. GO TO the storm's power.
  • Walk up to the tower, and break it. GO TO The Rainmaker.

links.clause: If there is a Blue character in your party) Reach up into the storm

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-kite-cut.html: The tether parts with a twang, and the kite sails off over the plain, with the rainmaker running after it, shouting. The storm she was holding breaks all at once, and the rain comes down on the whole plain, as if it had been saving up. GO TO The Rainmaker.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-master-s-b.title: The Master's Bout
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-master-s-b.html:
The Master's Bout
Enemy HP: 6 + 11 per player
Enemy
Brawler (#16)
Assassin (#42)
Outcome
Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The master helps you up, smiling. Losing costs no curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the master's lesson. If you lost, GO TO the monks' offerings.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-master-s-l.html: The master picks herself up, laughing, and spends the afternoon showing you what she saw you do wrong. Everyone may look through their training deck for an attack, and buy it at its EXP cost, then shuffle it. GO TO the monks' offerings.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-master-ste.html: The monk with the tray sets it down, and bows. “I am the master,” she says, and steps out onto the flagstones with one of the brothers. GO TO The Master's Bout.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-monks-offe.html:
The monks sell what they make: prayer beads and tea. For those who need it, they also offer a night of silence.

ItemPrice
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)3 gold
1x random Uncommon Potion, the monks' teaItem value

You may rest here tonight, at the cost of 3 gold. If you do, everyone gains 2 EXP from the evening's meditation.

Once you're done, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-pick-of-th.html: You slip out of the camp with the pick of the wagon, and you're past the well when a sentry's lamp swings round, and finds you. You gain 1x random Uncommon Weapon. GO TO Caught Red-Handed.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-quartermas.html:
The quartermaster lets down the tailboard of her wagon. If you lost, every price is 2 gold more: the camp respects a winner.

ItemPrice
2x random Common WeaponItem value
2x random Uncommon ArmorItem value
1x random Uncommon WeaponItem value + 3 gold

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-rainmaker.title: The Rainmaker
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-rainmaker.html:
The rainmaker pulls her goggles down, and throws a lever. The tower hums, its guards swivel round, and lightning walks down out of the dark cloud to meet them.

The Rainmaker
Enemy HP: 10 + 10 per player
Enemy
Artificer (#37)
Arc Sentry (#8)
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 gold, from the rainmaker's till.
  • 1x random Uncommon Travel item, from her workshop.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, the tower comes down, and the rain it hoarded comes down with it, all over the plain. STOP READING. If you lost, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-storm-s-po.html: The lightning comes down to you instead of the tower, and stays. Your hair stands on end, and sparks crawl over your knuckles. The rainmaker takes one look at you, and throws her lever anyway. The Blue character draws 4 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO The Rainmaker.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:woodlands.html:
In a hollow among the oaks, a ring of pale mushrooms glows faintly in the dusk. Inside it, a dozen frogs sit perfectly still, watching you. Every so often, one of them blinks out of existence, and back in again, facing a different way. A ring like that, the old tales say, will carry you far, if you can make it.

Choose one
  • Turn your coat inside out, as the old tales say, and step into the ring. GO TO inside out.
  • Step into the ring as you are. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:you-ve-seen-hi.html: The camp's champion favours his left, drops his guard when he grins, and grins a lot. When he steps into the ring with you, you're waiting for the grin. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO First Blood.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:caught-with-a-spa.html: His story has more holes in it than the churchyard, and there's fresh earth under his nails. He sees you see it, drops his bells, and runs, just as the first grave behind him sits up. You were watching the churchyard already. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Saints Preserve Us.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:deserts.html:
A dust cloud on the horizon resolves into riders in white and gold, the emir's banner snapping over them. Their captain reins in beside you. “By order of the Emir, all travelers pay the road tax. Six gold.” He looks you over, and his riders spread out. You get the feeling he'd take you as payment too.

Choose one
  • (Pay 6 gold) Hand over the tax. GO TO the tax paid.
  • Refuse. GO TO Tax Evasion.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:frostbitten.title: Frostbitten
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:frostbitten.html:
The travellers the toll didn't help lie stiff and blue in the snow. Frost walks over them on small, sharp legs, and behind it comes something big and grey that has been eating them.

Frostbitten
Enemy HP: 13 per player
Enemy
Rimelings (#35)
Ice Troll (#7)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, from a frozen traveller.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:holy-orders.title: Holy Orders
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:holy-orders.html:
The pilgrim squeals, and the large men who had been sleeping off last night under the cart remember, slowly, what they're paid for.

Holy Orders
Enemy HP: 13 per player
Enemy
Drunken Townsfolk (#13)
Brawler (#16)
Outcome
Victory
  • His takings: Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5), 2x random Uncommon Potion (the goddess's tears) and 6 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:knives-out.title: Knives Out
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:knives-out.html:
Her crew stay in the longboat to jeer, and their captain comes over the side alone, still grinning, with three ravens screeching round her head.

Knives Out
Enemy HP: 12 + 10 per player, or 9 + 8 if you holed their longboat
Enemy
Ringleader (#12)
Raven (#14)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon, and take back any items you set aside.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • Any items you set aside are gone. If you set none aside, each player loses an item of Common or Uncommon rarity.
  • 6 exp for each player.

Win or lose, the longboat rows away. GO TO another day at sea.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:mountains.html:
Someone has built a wall across the pass, with a gate and a squat stone tower, and a dwarf in a very large helmet is leaning out of its window. “Toll,” he says. “Two gold a head. Six for Shackled. All of you together, six. I'm not greedy.”

Choose one
  • (Pay 6 gold) Go through the gate. GO TO through the gate.
  • Go over the wall. GO TO Tolls of War.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:oceans.html:
A longboat full of pirates pulls alongside, and a woman with a knife in each hand stands in its bow, grinning. “Nice raft,” she says. “We'll take whatever's on it.”

Choose one
  • (Each player sets aside an item of Common or Uncommon rarity) Hand over your valuables. GO TO pleasure doing business.
  • (Discard the top 3 adventure cards) Ram the longboat where it sits lowest in the water, and spend the day patching the raft afterwards. GO TO shipping water.
  • Fight for your belongings. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:plains.title: Plains
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:plains.html:
A painted cart stands at the crossroads, hung with little bells and a portrait of Adrai'lalth that someone has touched up, generously, in gold leaf. Its owner, a round man in a pilgrim's robe, spreads his arms at the sight of you. “Pilgrims! Relics, blessings, holy water. Everything the faithful need, at prices the faithful can afford.” Behind him, every grave in the churchyard has been opened, recently, and very carefully.

Choose one
  • Look over his relics. GO TO the relic cart.
  • Ask him where his relics come from. GO TO caught with a spade.
  • (+1 curse) Relieve him of his takings. GO TO Holy Orders.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:pleasure-doing-bu.html: “Pleasure doing business,” she says, and passes your valuables back to her crew, who start squabbling over them at once. Then she looks at the raft. She meant all of it. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:saints-preserve-u.title: Saints Preserve Us
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:saints-preserve-u.html:
The dead come out of the churchyard in their burial clothes, slow and determined, and at their head walks a tall skeleton with a halo of rusted wire, missing one finger.

Saints Preserve Us
Enemy HP: 16 + 9 per player
Enemy
Raised Bones (#3)
Raised Commander (#10)
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 gold, from the cash box the pilgrim left on his cart.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:shipping-water.html: The raft hits the longboat where it's low, and the sea pours in over the side. Half the pirates drop their knives and grab buckets. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-hut-on-hen-s-.title: The Hut on Hen's Legs
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-hut-on-hen-s-.html:
You put a torch to the hut. It rears up, flinging its door wide, and out come the witch and her wolves. Under the floor, the snoring doesn't even stop.

The Hut on Hen's Legs
Enemy HP: 12 + 10 per player
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Witch (#32)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Uncommon Potion, from the witch's shelves.
  • 5 gold, from under the floorboards.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-relic-cart.html:
A finger bone of Saint Oswin. A splinter from the goddess's cradle. A vial of her tears, slightly cloudy. Most of it is fake. Not all of it.

ItemPrice
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)3 gold
2x random Uncommon Potion, the goddess's tearsItem value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemItem value

You're still counting your change when the churchyard behind the cart begins to stir. Saint Oswin, it seems, would like his finger back, and he's brought the congregation. GO TO Saints Preserve Us.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-tax-paid.html: The captain weighs the purse, hands it to an outrider, and looks you over again, more slowly. Then he decides the Emir's bounty on the Shackled isn't worth the trouble, and waves you on. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-witch-s-cauld.html:
“Square,” the witch agrees, and sets a cauldron on the fire. “Now. I can brew you something special, if you have something to put in.” You may rest here tonight, at the cost of 2 gold. She brews, as often as you like:

ItemPrice
1x random Common Potion3 gold
1x random Uncommon Potion1 curse: a little piece of your soul, in the pot

Once you're finished, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-witch-s-suppe.html:
The door is opened by an orc woman in an apron, with a ladle in one hand and a string of little bottles clinking at her throat. She feeds you first, and the stew is the best you've ever had. Afterwards, she wipes her hands and points the ladle at the floor. “Something's moved in under my hut. It snores, it stinks, and it's eaten two of my wolves. Get it out, and we'll call it square.” Everyone gains 2 EXP, from the stew.

Choose one
  • Stamp on the floor until it comes out. GO TO Under the Floorboards.
  • Thank her for the stew, and go on your way. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:through-the-gate.html: He counts it twice. Then, as the gate swings open on a pass white with frost, he looks a little ashamed of himself, and leans out of the window. “Mind the pass,” he says. “Toll pays for the wall. Not for what's past it. Keep left of the dead tree.” Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Frostbitten.

links.clause: If you won

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:woodlands.html:
A hut stands in the clearing on two enormous hen's legs, scratching idly at the dirt. Smoke curls from its chimney with a smell of stew, mostly wonderful. On the doorstep, a wolf the size of a pony watches you with polite interest. From under the floorboards comes a snore, much bigger than the wolf.

Choose one
  • Knock. GO TO the witch's supper.
  • (+1 curse) Burn it down, witch and all, and take what's on her shelves. GO TO The Hut on Hen's Legs.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-tastier-morsel.html: The tentacle takes the meat, considers it, and lets go of your ankle to get a better grip on it. It sinks away with its prize. The fight has one Monstrosity's Appendage fewer. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:arm-s-length.title: Arm's Length
ev:13-the-relic-seller:arm-s-length.html:
An arm comes up over the logs, then another, and another. Under the raft, something vast shifts its weight, and the sea boils.

Arm's Length
Enemy HP: 9 + 11 per player
Enemy
4×Monstrosity's Appendage (#49)
Outcome
Victory
  • 5 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The kraken takes the raft, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 7 exp for each player.

If you won, the arms let go, and the sea boils as something vast sulks away. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:13-the-relic-seller:chipping-crystals.html: The crystals come loose with a crack, and a puff of yellow, and a faint, high squeal. The broken ones bleed sparks, and the vent begins to click. You gain 8 gold. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:13-the-relic-seller:deserts.html:
On a salt flat, an old woman of the water nomads kneels with her ear to the ground, frowning. It's been humming since dawn, she tells you: two long things, turning over under the salt, and getting closer to her people's camp beyond the flat. She's going out to meet them, with nothing but a stick and the old songs, and she doesn't expect to come back.

Choose one
  • Go out with her, and keep her alive while she listens for them. GO TO listening to the salt.
  • Send her back to her camp, and go out alone to drum on the salt, and call them up to you. GO TO drumming them up.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:drumming-them-up.html: You drum on the salt with your boots and the flats of your blades until the ground starts drumming back. Whatever they've swallowed on their way here, they'll bring it up with them. The fight has no Civilian. GO TO Salt of the Earth.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:fire-eats-smoke.html: The backfire roars into the drifting clouds, and tears the biggest of them apart before it can gather itself, into a great many small, hungry pieces. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round, and the fight has one Soot Biter more. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:half-a-raft.html: The lashings part, and the arm drags half the raft under, with half of everything that was tied to it. It comes back up for the rest, slower, and puzzled. Each player loses an item of Common or Uncommon rarity. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:listening-to-the-.html: She walks the flat with her eyes closed, and stops dead. “Here,” she says, “and there,” and points with her stick, a heartbeat before the salt splits open. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Salt of the Earth.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:13-the-relic-seller:mountains.html:
Following a smell of rotten eggs, you find a vent in the mountainside breathing yellow fumes. The rock around it is studded with crystals the colour of embers, warm to the touch, worth good money in any town. Every so often, one of them twitches. Down in the vent, where the fumes are thickest, the big ones glow like coals.

Choose one
  • Smash them before they hatch. GO TO smashed in the shell.
  • Chip a few from the edge. GO TO chipping crystals.
  • (Everyone adds an Exhaustion) Climb down into the fumes, where the big ones are. GO TO the big ones.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:13-the-relic-seller:oceans.html:
A tentacle as thick as a mast rises beside the raft, feels its way along the logs like a blind man reading, and finds your ankle. Wherever you cut it, it grows back, and all around the raft, more are rising.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Beast Meat) Offer it something tastier. GO TO a tastier morsel.
  • Cut the raft's lashings, and let it have the half it's holding. GO TO half a raft.
  • Hack at it. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:plains.title: Plains
ev:13-the-relic-seller:plains.html:
A grass fire has swept this stretch of the plains, leaving it black to the horizon. The flames are long gone, but the smoke isn't. It drifts low over the ash in little clouds, against the wind, and it's drifting towards you. Beyond it stands the shell of a burned farmstead.

Choose one
  • (Everyone adds an Exhaustion) Hold your breath, and walk through it to the far side, where it's thinnest. GO TO the thin side.
  • Light a backfire, and let the wind carry it into them. GO TO fire eats smoke.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:salt-of-the-earth.title: Salt of the Earth
ev:13-the-relic-seller:salt-of-the-earth.html:
The sand wurms rise out of the salt flat like towers falling the wrong way, all mouth.

Salt of the Earth
Enemy HP: 17 + 9 per player
Enemy
Monstrosity's Head (#48)
Civilian (#43)
Additional Rules
  • The Civilian is the old woman.
Outcome
Victory
  • If she came with you and lives, her people's thanks: 1x random Uncommon Travel item, and the loan of their fastest camels: you and your allies may move up to 2 locations through Deserts.
  • If you drummed them up alone: 8 gold and 1x random Uncommon item, from what the wurms brought up.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:smashed-in-the-sh.html: You go along the rock with the pommel of your sword, and a good many of the crystals never hatch at all. The fight has one Emberskitter fewer. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-big-ones.html: You come back up coughing, with your arms full, and something comes up after you. You gain 14 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-thin-side.html: You come out of the smoke on the far side, eyes streaming and coughing your lungs up, with most of it still drifting the wrong way behind you. The fight has one Soot Biter fewer. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:up-in-smoke.title: Up in Smoke
ev:13-the-relic-seller:up-in-smoke.html:
The clouds gather into shapes with a great many teeth, and one of them gathers into something much bigger.

Up in Smoke
Enemy HP: 13 + 10 per player
Enemy
Soot Biter (#5)
Soot Devourer (#29)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Travel item and 6 gold, from the cellar of the burned farmstead.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:between-the-coils.html: You slip between the coils, and pin one flat against the raft's edge, where it can't tighten. Then another rises under the raft, and lifts it clean out of the sea, right in front of the head. The fight has one Monstrosity's Appendage fewer. GO TO Coiled.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:coiled.title: Coiled
ev:14-tolls-of-war:coiled.html:
Coiled
Enemy HP: 17 per player
Enemy
Monstrosity's Head (#48)
Monstrosity's Appendage (#49)
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • A coil comes down on the raft, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the serpent sinks, coil by coil, until the sea is only the sea again. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:14-tolls-of-war:hunting-the-hunters.html: They come to the net in a bunch, laughing, with their bows on their backs. The unicorn watches you rise out of the grass behind them, and it doesn't look grateful. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:nets-and-arrows.title: Nets and Arrows
ev:14-tolls-of-war:nets-and-arrows.html:
The hunters spread out around the net, and nock their arrows. “That was ours,” says the one in front.

Nets and Arrows
Enemy HP: 13 + 12 per player
Enemy
Poacher (#4)
Ranger (#24)
Outcome
Victory
  • Longbow (Common Weapon #6) and 4 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won and left the unicorn in the net, you cut it free, and it bolts for the woods without a backward glance. STOP READING. Otherwise, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:14-tolls-of-war:oceans.html:
The swell ahead isn't a swell. It's a coil, grey-green and crusted with barnacles, rising and sinking in a long, slow wave. Then another beside it, and another, until the raft is drifting through a maze of serpent. Far ahead, a head the size of a boat turns, and looks back down its own length at you.

Choose one
  • (Discard the top 3 adventure cards) Paddle hard for a gap before it closes, and meet the head in open water. GO TO through the gap.
  • Steer between the coils as they rise. GO TO between the coils.
  • Draw your weapons, and wait for the head to come to you. GO TO Coiled.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:plains.title: Plains
ev:14-tolls-of-war:plains.html:
Near the edge of the woods, a white horse is tangled in a hunter's net, thrashing. Then it turns its head, and you see the horn on its brow, spiralled like a seashell and bright as new silver. Somewhere close, a hunting horn sounds: the hunters are coming back for their catch.

Choose one
  • Calm it, and cut it free. GO TO the unicorn's thanks.
  • Leave it in the net for bait, and wait for the hunters in the long grass. GO TO hunting the hunters.
  • (+2 curse) Take the horn. GO TO the horn.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-horn.html:
It takes a long time. The unicorn doesn't stop looking at you, not once, not even at the end. The hunters arrive just after the end, and see what you've done to their catch.

You gain 3x random Uncommon Potion and 20 gold. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-unicorn-s-thanks.html: It stands still for you, trembling, while you cut the last cord. Then it lowers its head and touches the horn to each of your brows in turn, and every ache you've carried today goes out like a candle. You're still standing there, dazed, when the hunters come out of the trees. Everyone gains 5 EXP. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:through-the-gap.html: The coils close behind you with a sound like a sigh, and you're out in open water, with room to fight, when the head comes round. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Coiled.

ev:15-the-unicorn:open-for-business.html:
Win or lose, the jackals have had enough of you, and slink off into the grass. The creature slides down the drainpipe, takes an excited hop, and bows deeply. "Customers do like things, I hear. Please help yourself to some gold so you may purchase a thing."

Choose one
  • Turn around and leave. I want absolutely nothing to do with this. GO TO Leave the shop.
  • (+10 gold). Take the gold and leave. Hey, free gold! GO TO Take the gold.
  • (+10 gold). Take the gold and enter the store. GO TO Enter the shop.

ev:15-the-unicorn:plains.title: Plains
ev:15-the-unicorn:plains.html:
A stone building stands alone on the plain: a shop, in surprisingly good repair, under a sign in elaborate cursive that simply reads "Things". Beside it, a copper bowl on a stone pillar brims with gold coins. A pack of jackals circles the shop, snapping at a creature on its roof: a thing of pure black, flat as a tall man's shadow held upright, hopping from foot to foot along the ridge.

It sees you and waves both arms. "Customers, at last! Would you be so kind as to remove the other customers? They don't buy anything." The jackals turn, and the biggest of them, a scarred grey brute, decides you'll do instead. GO TO Bad for Business.

ev:2:a-gull-s-share.html: The meat hits the water, and some of the flock goes after it instead, screaming at each other. The fight has one Raven fewer. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:2:a-line-in-the-shoal.html: The fish are biting, and so are the gulls, and you have only one hand free for them. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:2:a-murder-of-crows.title: A Murder of Crows
ev:2:a-murder-of-crows.html:
As you turn to go, the crow stops squawking. It sits very still on its branch, and turns its head to follow you all the way round, and its eyes begin to glow with a sickly light. Then it screams, and the canopy answers: black wings pour down from every branch, with the same light in their eyes.

A Murder of Crows
Enemy HP: 9 + 8 per player
Enemy
4×Raven (#14)
Outcome
Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • The crows take the purse back: lose 4 gold.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the crows scatter. If you lost, GO TO the flock keeps watch.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:2:between-a-roc-and-a-hard-place.title: Between a Roc and a Hard Place

ev:2:coins-in-the-moss.html: The crow watches you take them, and says nothing. You don't look back. You gain 4 gold. STOP READING.

ev:2:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:2:deserts.html:
From the top of a dune, you watch a caravan crawl along the valley floor below, its camels roped nose to tail. It isn't alone: riders on pale horses are closing on it from both sides, scarves over their faces. They've done this before, and they do it well.

Choose one
  • Lie flat on the crest, and watch how they work. You'll certainly learn something. GO TO watching the raid.
  • Ride down to the caravan's aid. GO TO Sand and Deliver.
  • (If there is a Red character in your party) Circle round behind the dunes, and hit them from the flank. GO TO from the flank.

links.clause: If there is a Red character in your party) Circle round behind the dunes

ev:2:fowl-weather.title: Fowl Weather
ev:2:fowl-weather.html:
They come at you beak first, and they don't much care which of you is holding the food.

Fowl Weather
Enemy HP: 8 + 7 per player
Enemy
Raven (#14)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you cast a line: 2x Beast Meat (Common Travel #10), the catch.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, the wind holds, and the last gulls fall away astern: you may move to a connected Ocean sector. Win or lose, GO TO another day at sea.

links.clause: If you won

ev:2:from-the-flank.html: You keep below the crest until you're behind them, then come down the dune at a gallop. The riders turn to meet one threat and find you at their backs, and one of them breaks off and flees before the fighting starts. The fight has one Bandit fewer. GO TO Sand and Deliver.

ev:2:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:2:mountains.html: High on a ridge, the bones of goats, and of things a good deal bigger than goats, lie scattered round a nest built of whole pine trees. A shadow sweeps over the rocks, and circles back. A Roc is wheeling over the ridge, with a wingspan wider than a village square, and it has just folded its wings to dive. GO TO Between a Roc and a Hard Place.

ev:2:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:2:oceans.html:
For once, the sea behaves. The wind holds steady at your back, and nothing with teeth takes an interest in you. Then the raft drifts into a boiling shoal of silver fish, and over it a shrieking white cloud of gulls, diving for their dinner. They don't care to share it, and they come at you beak first.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Beast Meat) Throw them something easier to eat. GO TO a gull's share.
  • Cast a line into the shoal while you fight them off one-handed. GO TO a line in the shoal.
  • Swat at them. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:2:plains.title: Plains
ev:2:plains.html:
Dusk finds you passing a farmstead on the plains, its shutters already closed for the night. A girl of no more than ten skips down the lane towards you, without a trace of fear. “Look what I found!” she says, holding up something that's plainly worth a great deal. Take a random Rare Travel item, and set it on the table: it's the one she's holding.

Choose one
  • (+1 curse) Snatch it from her hand. “Fantastic! I've been looking for that.” GO TO snatched.
  • Offer her half its value in gold, rounded up. “Wouldn't you rather have these? Look, shiny!” GO TO a lowball offer.
  • (Pay its value in gold, or give an item worth as much) Offer her a fair trade. “I could use that. How about a swap?” GO TO a fair trade.

ev:2:the-crow-s-bargain.html: You caw, and the crow caws back. It considers you with one black eye, then the other, and you haggle for a while, in croaks and clicks. Then it flies up, works at the branch, and drops a purse at your feet: a noble's crest, heavy with coin, and a little stoppered vial tangled in its strings. The crow flaps off to find something shinier, very pleased with the deal. You gain 4 gold and 1x random Common Potion. STOP READING.

ev:2:the-crow-s-prize.html:
It's a purse stitched with a noble's crest, heavy with coin. Tangled in its strings is a little stoppered vial the crow was clearly saving for a special occasion.

You gain 4 gold and 1x random Common Potion. GO TO A Murder of Crows.

ev:2:the-crows-scatter.html: The light goes out of the crows' eyes, and they scatter over the treetops, free of whatever bound them to the gold. You watch them go for a long time. You know a thing or two about curses. STOP READING.

ev:2:the-flock-keeps-watch.html: The flock settles back into the oak, to keep its watch. STOP READING.

ev:2:watching-the-raid.html: They cut the last camels loose first, then drive the guards into a knot, and an archer picks off whoever breaks from it. It's over in minutes. The caravan master kneels in the sand, and you take notes. Something cold settles in your chest as you watch him beg, and the Shackle tightens. +1 curse. Everyone gains 5 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:2:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:2:woodlands.html:
A crow keeps landing on the same branch of an enormous oak, pecking at something that glints, then flying off in disgust. Whatever it is, it's shiny, it's stuck, and it's a very long way up. Two coins lie in the moss at the roots, where the crow has dropped them.

Choose one
  • (Someone adds an Exhaustion to their deck) Climb for it. GO TO the crow's prize.
  • (If there is a Green character in your party) Call to the crow in its own tongue. GO TO the crow's bargain.
  • Pocket the coins, and leave the crow to its problem. GO TO coins in the moss.

links.clause: If there is a Green character in your party) Call to the crow in its own tongue

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-cry-behind-y.html: You've barely said your goodbyes when the traveler cries out behind you. The meal has drawn company, and the traveler has nothing to hold it off with but a stick from the embers. GO TO Stranger Danger.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-game-in-the-.html: The leader grins under the veil, and scratches a ring in the sand with a camel stick. Strangers who share the nomads' road share their game first: two teams, bare hands, and the losers fetch the water. GO TO Kicking Up Sand.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-harmless-ped.html:
The traveler throws both hands up before you've finished drawing. Under the cowl is an old peddler, who empties a pack onto the ground and backs away from it, trembling.

You gain 8 gold, 2x random Common item and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.

The peddler bolts into the grass, and the grass shivers and closes behind them. Something out there has been waiting for the fire to go out. The fight has no Civilian. GO TO Stranger Danger.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-knight-to-re.title: A Knight to Remember
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-knight-to-re.html:
The traveler stands, and wool slides off mail: a knight, travelling plain to avoid exactly this kind of trouble. She draws her sword with a tired sigh, and her two squires come pelting down the hill from their firewood, each dragging a shield bigger than he is.

A Knight to Remember
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Knight (#45)
Protector (#23)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, 1x random Uncommon Weapon and 2 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:bad-water.title: Bad Water
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:bad-water.html:
The nomads don't seem surprised. They've met the Shackled before. Their riders wheel their camels round, drawing curved swords, while the women and children lead the string away across the sand. Two old women stay behind, and the air around their hands begins to shimmer. The Shackle tightens. +1 curse.

Bad Water
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Mage (#39)
Outcome
Victory
  • Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1), 2x Waterskin (Common Travel #7) and 3 gold, from the camels they left behind.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:barter.html:
The traveler unrolls a blanket of odds and ends, and shakes their head when you reach for your purse. “Coin's no use out here. Goods for goods.”

ItemPrice
3x random Common itemAn item of at least its value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemAn item of at least its value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:called-by-name.html: You piece the name together from the scratches, and call it across the water. The laughter stops. When the crew comes up out of the hold, they come slowly, looking to their captain, and their captain doesn't know what to tell them. Some of them won't raise a hand against him, and stay below. He remembers who he was, and whatever he kept in his cabin, he means to take down with him. The fight has one Raised Bones fewer. GO TO Dead Man's Chest.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:dead-man-s-che.title: Dead Man's Chest
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:dead-man-s-che.html:
The barrels in the hold begin to open from the inside, and the crew comes up the ladders to meet you, all bone under the rags, in no particular hurry. Last of all comes the captain, still laughing, and you can see the ladder through him.

Dead Man's Chest
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Raised Bones (#3)
Phantasm (#47)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Travel item and 4 gold, from the stores.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won and didn't call the captain by name, GO TO the captain's chart. You row away before the fog closes in again. GO TO another day at sea.

links.clause: If you won and didn't call the captain by name

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:deserts.html:
A string of camels comes out of the heat haze, bells ringing. The water nomads walk beside them, veiled against the sand. Their leader raises an open hand.

Choose one
  • Return the greeting. GO TO a game in the sand.
  • Return the greeting, then reach for your weapons. GO TO Bad Water.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:fair-game.title: Fair Game
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:fair-game.html:
The traveler rolls aside and comes up with a loaded crossbow. A poacher, by the smell of the pelts under the cloak, and a sharp whistle brings his friends down out of the sky: three hunting hawks.

Fair Game
Enemy HP: 9 + 8 per player
Enemy
Poacher (#4)
Raven (#14)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x Beast Meat (Common Travel #10), 1x random Common Weapon and 6 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:forget-me-not.title: Forget Me Not
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:forget-me-not.html:
As you step away from the little door, the moss between the roots begins to quiver. Pale, wobbling lumps ooze out from under the beeches and roll after you. You wonder whether you've seen them before, but the memory is shaky, like a word on the tip of your tongue. Behind them, something else drifts up out of the roots: a pale shape in a traveler's cloak, a customer who sold one memory too many, and forgot to leave. It reaches for your pack as if it were its own.

Forget Me Not
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Slime (#33)
Phantasm (#47)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Travel item, from the forgotten customer's pack, left among the roots.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grave-robbery.title: Grave Robbery
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grave-robbery.html:
The traveler rises, unhurried, and the cowl falls back on a skull with two cold embers for eyes. It was never travelling alone: its company rises with it, rusted blades in bony hands. The dead are on the road to the goddess, and they don't take kindly to delays.

Grave Robbery
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Raised Bones (#3)
Raised Commander (#10)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the Commander's bones.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:hex-marks-the-.title: Hex Marks the Spot
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:hex-marks-the-.html:
The traveler doesn't reach for a weapon. They sigh and push back the cowl: an orc woman, older than you expected, with a string of tiny bottles clinking at her throat. She whistles once. Something in the dark whistles back.

Hex Marks the Spot
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Witch (#32)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Common Potion and 1x random Uncommon Potion, from her necklace.
  • 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:kicking-up-san.title: Kicking Up Sand
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:kicking-up-san.html:
The nomads hand their swords to the children, roll up their sleeves, and wade into the ring, laughing.

Kicking Up Sand
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Brawler (#16)
Additional Rules
  • No weapons: players can't use their Weapon items.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x Waterskin (Common Travel #7): the nomads fetch the water.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • Losing costs no curse.
  • You fetch the water. Nobody gets hurt.
  • 6 exp for each player.

Win or lose, the nomads slap the sand off your backs like old friends. GO TO the nomads' wares.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:knock-twice.html: At the second knock, the smoke round the door stops leaking, and starts pouring. It comes out of the cracks in long black ropes, and gathers on the path around you, and one cloud of it keeps growing. GO TO Knock Knock.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:memories-of-th.html:
You open your hand, and the dead you carry spill out across the counter: a drowned man's last breath, a soldier's first kiss, a grandmother's lullaby. The ferret's whiskers tremble. “Oh,” it says. “Oh, these are vintage.” It pushes the whole stock across the counter, and won't hear of change.

You gain 2x random Uncommon Potion and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:mountains.html:
Around a bend in the path, a door is set into the mountainside: iron-bound, three times your height, with a much smaller door cut into it at dwarf height. Black smoke leaks round its edges. A brass plate reads, in six languages: TRADE ENTRANCE. KNOCK ONCE. DO NOT KNOCK TWICE.

Choose one
  • Knock once. GO TO the trade entrance.
  • Knock twice. GO TO knock twice.
  • (If there is a Red character in your party) Knock the door down. GO TO the door comes down.

links.clause: If there is a Red character in your party) Knock the door down

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:oceans.html:
A ship drifts out of the fog with its sails in rags and nobody at the wheel. Its name has been scraped off the bow, carefully, by someone who didn't want it remembered. From the captain's cabin, faint and patient, comes the sound of someone laughing.

Choose one
  • Piece together what's left of the name, and call the captain by it. GO TO called by name.
  • Board quietly, and search the hold before anything notices. GO TO the empty ship.
  • Board with your blades out. GO TO Dead Man's Chest.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:plains.title: Plains
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:plains.html:
A lone traveler camps at the edge of the road beside the remains of a meager meal, stoking smoldering embers. Their features lie concealed under a heavy cowl.

Choose one
  • Offer to barter. GO TO barter.
  • Ask about the road ahead. GO TO the traveler's news.

  • Shouldn't have camped alone. Pull out your weapons. GO TO rob the traveler.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:push-past-the-.html: The dwarf is quicker than you expected, and louder. Before you've reached the first rack, a bell is clanging somewhere in the mountain, and doors are banging open all the way down the hall, and the Shackle tightens. +1 curse. GO TO Smash and Grab.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rob-the-travel.html:
The traveler watches you draw steel, and doesn't move. Under the cowl, something makes up its mind, and the Shackle tightens. +1 curse.

Spin the weather vane, and go to:

VaneUnder the cowl
NGO TO a harmless peddler
NE, NW, E, WGO TO Fair Game
SEGO TO A Knight to Remember
SWGO TO Hex Marks the Spot
SGO TO Grave Robbery

links.clause: N
NE, NW, E, W
SE
SW
S

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:smash-and-grab.title: Smash and Grab
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:smash-and-grab.html:
Mailed dwarves with shields close in around you, and none of them are smiling. Behind them, two brass wardens come clanking down the hall, crackling.

Smash and Grab
Enemy HP: 9 + 7 per player
Enemy
Protector (#23)
Arc Sentry (#8)
Outcome
Victory
  • Every item you saw on the forge's racks.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:stranger-dange.title: Stranger Danger
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:stranger-dange.html:
Lean shapes slink out of the grass, drawn by the smell of the meal, and they don't much mind who they share it with.

Stranger Danger
Enemy HP: 10 per player
Enemy
4×Pack Predator (#2)
Civilian (#43)
Additional Rules
  • The Civilian is the traveler. If it dies, you lose the fight.
Outcome
Victory
  • If you saved the traveler, 1x random Common Travel item, from the traveler's pack.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-captain-s-.html: The captain's cabin is bare but for a sea chest nailed to the floor, and in it, rolled tight in oilskin, a chart of a coast you don't know, marked in a careful hand with harbours, wrecks and places the captain meant to see again. You follow it along the currents he marked. You may move up to 2 connected Ocean sectors. Then row away before the fog closes in again: GO TO another day at sea.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-door-comes.html: The little door gives at the second kick, and comes off its hinges with a crash that echoes all the way into the mountain. Behind it, a very large, very old dwarf in a leather apron looks at the door, then at you, and laughs until he has to sit down on an anvil. “Nobody's done that in three hundred years,” he wheezes. “Come in, come in.” GO TO the forge's racks.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-empty-ship.html: The deck is empty, the galley cold, the captain's log blank from the first page to the last. Down in the hold, barrels of water and biscuit sit neatly roped, as if waiting for a crew that went ashore and forgot to come back. You've hauled one onto the raft when the hatch slams shut above you. You gain 1x random Common Travel item. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Dead Man's Chest.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-forge-s-ra.html:
Behind the little door, racks of steel climb into the dark, every blade stamped with the same rune. If you knocked the door down, every price is half, rounded up.

ItemPrice
2x random Common WeaponItem value
2x random Common ArmorItem value
1x random Uncommon WeaponItem value
1x random Uncommon ArmorItem value
Choose one
  • Trade, and go on your way. STOP READING.
  • Push past the dwarf, and help yourself. GO TO push past the dwarf.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-memory-sho.html:
Each memory you sell leaves a small, clean hole behind: the name of a childhood friend, the taste of your mother's bread, what you were doing yesterday morning.

For each memory you pay, add an Exhaustion to your deck: it stays until you rest.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon PotionOne memory each
1x random Uncommon Travel itemTwo memories

Once you're done trading, GO TO Forget Me Not. If you sold any memories, the fight has one Slime more.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-nomads-war.html:
ItemPrice
Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1)7 gold
Waterskin (Common Travel #7)2 gold
1x random Uncommon Travel itemItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-trade-entr.html:
The little door opens on a cloud of soot, and a dwarf with a blackened face coughs it out at you. “Chimney's blocked,” he says. “Something's nesting in the flue, and now it's in the shop, eating the coal and biting the customers. You look like you can swing a sword. Clear it out, and I'll open the racks for you.”

Choose one
  • Help him. GO TO Chimney Sweep.
  • Leave him to his soot. STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-traveler-s.html:
“News?” The traveler laughs, low and hoarse, and pokes at the embers. “I've just come down the road you're about to take. That's the only news worth having.” Which bridge is out, which stretch to clear before dark, which inn waters its ale: the traveler knows it all.

Look at the top 2 cards of the adventure deck and return them to the top in any order. GO TO a cry behind you.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:woodlands.html:
Beside the path, a little door is set into the roots of a beech tree, painted blue, with a sign: OPEN (FOR NOW). Behind it, a ferret you can see straight through sits at a counter made from a mushroom cap, selling things far too large to have fit through the door.

“Gold?” it says, wrinkling its nose. “How vulgar. I take memories.”

Choose one
  • Shop. GO TO the memory shop.
  • (If there is a Black character in your party) Offer it the memories of the dead instead. GO TO memories of the dead.
  • Back away slowly. GO TO Forget Me Not.

links.clause: If there is a Black character in your party) Offer it the memories of the dead instead

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html: You take the sword from the one holding it wrong, turn it round, and hand it back. Then you show them the rest: pick a mark who can't run, never count in the open, and always, always listen to the dog. By sundown they're practising on each other, and they wave you off like old friends, promising to rob somebody else. Everyone gains 3 EXP. STOP READING.

Something moves on the dune crest, low and spotted, then something else. You have your back to the water before they're down the slope. Each player draws 1 more card in the fight's first round. GO TO Laughing Stock.
The overhang comes down with a sound like the end of the world, and when the white settles, fewer shapes climb out of it. The fight has one Pack Predator fewer. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Deserts
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
For an hour, the shimmer on the horizon refuses to go away. It turns out to be an oasis, and a real one: you check twice, the second time with your whole face in the water. Palm shade, sweet water, and a pool so clear you can count the coins at the bottom, thrown in for luck by travelers long gone. One of them never left: his packs lie half buried at the water's edge, picked over by something with teeth.

Choose one
  • (Each player may add an Exhaustion to their deck) Dive for the coins. GO TO the bottom of the pool.
  • Fill your waterskins, and keep an eye on the dunes. GO TO an eye on the dunes.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Mountains
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
The snow in the pass is churned with tracks, large and small, all heading the same way you are. Winter has driven the predators down from the peaks. Ahead, something howls, and something bigger answers.

Choose one
  • (Someone adds an Exhaustion to their deck) Climb to the snow overhang above the pass, and dig it loose: start an avalanche onto the pack as it comes through. GO TO buried in the pass.
  • Draw your weapons. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Oceans
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html: For once, the sea is empty in every direction, which is exactly how you like it. It doesn't last. GO TO pirates.

They bite every coin and argue over the split, their backs to you and the sword dropped in the grass between them. Even the dog has lost interest, and has its nose in your purse. As far as they're concerned, the business is done, and you were never a threat.

Choose one
  • Fall on them while they're counting. GO TO while they count.
  • Leave them to their quarrel. STOP READING.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Plains
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
Two bandits step out from behind a haystack and demand your purses, one of them holding a sword by the wrong end, the other none the wiser. Their dog, a mangy thing with more sense than both of them, slinks out after them and shows you its teeth.

Choose one
  • Face them on the road. GO TO Wrong End of the Sword.
  • (Pay 4 gold) Hand over the gold. GO TO paid off.
  • (If there is a Purple character in your party) Show them how it's really done. GO TO a lesson in banditry.

links.clause: If there is a Purple character in your party) Show them how it's really done

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html: Half the pack falls on the food, snapping at each other. The rest come at you alone. The fight has one Pack Predator fewer. GO TO Tooth and Claw.
You come up again and again with your fists full, until your ears ring. You gain 2 gold for each player who dove. GO TO Laughing Stock.

You get the satchel off his shoulders, but by the time you look up, the beasts have you surrounded. You gain 1x random Common Weapon. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Tooth and Claw.
You're on them before the last coin is bitten. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Wrong End of the Sword.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Woodlands
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
A low, rumbling growl disrupts the quietude of the forest. In a clearing ahead lies what's left of a hunter, his satchel still on his back. Bright, fierce pairs of eyes track you from behind the dimly lit underbrush. The hairs on the back of your neck stand up, leaving you with little doubt about the intent of these creatures.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Beast Meat) Toss your food into the brush, and let them squabble over it. GO TO squabbling over scraps.
  • Grab the dead hunter's satchel from the clearing before you back off. GO TO the hunter's satchel.
  • Raise your weapon and charge towards the source of the noise. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:41-the-market-town:the-drovers-yard.html:
Pens of cattle, strings of horses, and drovers who've walked every road in the land and worn out a pair of boots on each.

ItemPrice
Spare Horseshoes (Uncommon Travel #4)7 gold
Outrider's Whistle (Uncommon Travel #3)8 gold
Sturdy Tent (Common Travel #1)3 gold
Beast Meat (Common Travel #10)2 gold

The drovers buy any Travel item at its full value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:41-the-market-town:the-harvest.html: You spend the day with a scythe, or behind a cart, until your back aches and the barns are full. You gain 4 gold. STOP READING.

ev:41-the-market-town:the-hayloft.html: Straw in your hair, horses snoring below, and the cheapest bed in the land. You rest, for 1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:41-the-market-town:the-market-square.html:
Every stall in the square sells something different, and every stallholder swears theirs is the best of it.

ItemPrice
Ale (Common Potion #8)3 gold
Vitality Phial (Common Potion #1)2 gold
Clarity Phial (Common Potion #2)1 gold
Leather Boots (Common Armor #1)1 gold
Vitality Flask (Uncommon Potion #2)4 gold
Silk Gloves (Uncommon Armor #3)7 gold

The stallholders buy any item for half its value, rounded down. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:41-the-market-town:the-market-town.title: The Market Town
ev:41-the-market-town:the-market-town.html:
A market town at a crossroads, ringed by fields. Carts creak in from every farm around, heavy with the harvest, drovers bring their herds to the yards, and the farmers shout their prices over each other across the square.

Choose one
  • (Pay 2 gold) Sleep in the hayloft over the stables. GO TO the hayloft.
  • Visit the drovers' yard. GO TO the drovers' yard.
  • Browse the market square. GO TO the market square.
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Help with the harvest. GO TO the harvest.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:42-the-timber-town:the-bounty.title: The Bounty
ev:42-the-timber-town:the-bounty.html:
A wolf pack has been taking the loggers' mules, and the hunters have nailed a price on its leader to the lodge door: a grey wolf the size of a pony. They'll show you where the pack dens, but no further.

Wolf Bounty
Enemy HP: 13 per player
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Ravenous Beast (#46)
Additional Rules
  • One more Pack Predator for every 10 curse.
  • At 20 or more curse, enemy HP is 16 per player.
Outcome
Victory
  • The bounty: 6 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:42-the-timber-town:the-hunters.html:
The hunters keep their gear by the lodge door, oiled and sharp, and they'll part with the spares for coin.

ItemPrice
Hunting Knife (Common Weapon #5)1 gold
Hatchet (Common Weapon #2)2 gold
Longbow (Common Weapon #6)3 gold
Recurve Bow (Uncommon Weapon #7)6 gold
Fur Pelts (Common Travel #6)6 gold
Fishing Pole (Uncommon Travel #6)7 gold

The hunters buy any Weapon at its full value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:42-the-timber-town:the-hunters-lodge.html: Bunks, a roaring fire, antlers on every wall, and venison for breakfast. You rest, for 1 curse. One of you gains Beast Meat (Common Travel #10), wrapped for the road. STOP READING.

ev:42-the-timber-town:the-timber-town.title: The Timber Town
ev:42-the-timber-town:the-timber-town.html:
A timber town at the forest's edge, built out of the forest itself. Axes ring all day, sawdust drifts down the streets, and at dusk the hunters come back from under the trees with kills and stories.

Choose one
