  • (Pay 3 gold) Take a bunk at the hunters' lodge. GO TO the hunters' lodge.
  • Trade with the hunters. GO TO the hunters.
  • Visit the woodcarvers. GO TO the woodcarvers.
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Take the hunters' bounty. GO TO The Bounty.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:42-the-timber-town:the-woodcarvers.html:
Shavings curl on the floor of the long workshop. Everything here was a tree once, and some of it still remembers.

ItemPrice
Birch Wand (Common Weapon #3)3 gold
Oak Staff (Common Weapon #4)4 gold
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)3 gold
Torch (Common Travel #4)2 gold
Easel (Uncommon Travel #9)6 gold
Chromatic Staff (Uncommon Weapon #2)7 gold

The woodcarvers buy any item for half its value, rounded down. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:43-the-quarry-town:a-guide.html: She knows goat paths that aren't on any map, and a few that aren't on any mountain. You may move up to 2 locations, ignoring roads and the weather. STOP READING.

ev:43-the-quarry-town:a-room-with-a-view.html: A narrow bed under the eaves, and from the window, half the land below and every road across it. You rest, for 1 curse. Then look at the top 3 cards of the adventure deck, and put them back in any order. STOP READING.

ev:43-the-quarry-town:the-miners-store.html:
Everything a miner needs to go into the dark, and most of what they need to come back out.

ItemPrice
Rope (Common Travel #5)2 gold
Torch (Common Travel #4)2 gold
Prospector's Pick (Uncommon Travel #11)7 gold
Flint and Steel (Uncommon Travel #8)4 gold

The storekeeper buys any item for half its value, rounded down. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:43-the-quarry-town:the-quarry-town.title: The Quarry Town
ev:43-the-quarry-town:the-quarry-town.html:
A quarry town clinging to the mountainside, grey with stone dust. Picks ring in the quarries all day, the miners come up out of the dark at dusk, and the smiths rework whatever steel comes their way.

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Take a room at the top of the inn. GO TO a room with a view.
  • Visit the smithy. GO TO the smithy.
  • Browse the miners' store. GO TO the miners' store.
  • (Pay 3 gold, discard the top 4 adventure cards) Hire a guide over the passes. GO TO a guide.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:43-the-quarry-town:the-smithy.html:
The forge never goes out. The smiths will hammer anything into armour, and they've seen enough of it come back dented to know what works.

ItemPrice
Sallet (Common Armor #2)2 gold
Leather Hauberk (Common Armor #3)3 gold
Banded Shield (Common Armor #5)2 gold
Full Helmet (Uncommon Armor #2)6 gold
Tower Shield (Uncommon Armor #5)6 gold
Bardiche (Uncommon Weapon #1)4 gold

The smiths buy any Armor at its full value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:44-the-caravanserai:the-bazaar.html:
Traders from lands you've never heard of sit on bright rugs, and never say what anything is for.

ItemPrice
3x random Uncommon itemItem value
1x random Rare itemItem value

The traders buy any item for half its value, rounded down. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:44-the-caravanserai:the-caravanserai.title: The Caravanserai
ev:44-the-caravanserai:the-caravanserai.html:
A caravanserai round a deep well, walled against the sand. Camels kneel in the courtyard, traders from every road unroll their rugs under the arches, and here, water is worth more than gold.

Choose one
  • (Pay 6 gold) Take a room off the courtyard. GO TO the courtyard.
  • Visit the water sellers. GO TO the water sellers.
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Browse the bazaar of the far roads. GO TO the bazaar.
  • (Pay 5 gold, discard the top 4 adventure cards) Try your luck at the dice tables. GO TO the dice tables.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:44-the-caravanserai:the-courtyard.html: Cool tiles, clean water from the well, and the caravans' bells waking you at dawn. You rest, for 1 curse. Then, if you like, ride out with a caravan: you may move up to 2 locations, ignoring roads and the weather. STOP READING.

ev:44-the-caravanserai:the-dice-tables.html:
Bone dice, a brass cup, and a dealer who never seems to lose. Then again, neither do you, sometimes. Spin the weather vane:

VaneYour winnings
N15 gold
NE, NW10 gold
E, W5 gold
SE, SW, SNothing

STOP READING.

ev:44-the-caravanserai:the-water-sellers.html:
The water sellers sit by the well with everything a traveller needs to cross the sand alive, and they know exactly what that's worth.

ItemPrice
Waterskin (Common Travel #7)2 gold
Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1)7 gold
Compass (Common Travel #3)3 gold
Scimitar (Uncommon Weapon #4)5 gold

The water sellers buy any Travel item at its full value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:45-the-harbour-town:the-chandler.html:
Rope, lanterns, tar and brass. The chandler outfits every ship in the harbour, and anyone else with coin.

ItemPrice
Rope (Common Travel #5)2 gold
Compass (Common Travel #3)3 gold
Fishing Pole (Uncommon Travel #6)7 gold
Spyglass (Rare Travel #4)12 gold
Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1)18 gold

The chandler buys any item for half its value, rounded down. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:45-the-harbour-town:the-harbour-town.title: The Harbour Town
ev:45-the-harbour-town:the-harbour-town.html:
A harbour town, all salt and tar. Nets dry on every wall, gulls scream over the fish market, where the catch is sold before it stops moving, and the quays are a forest of masts, bound for every shore.

Choose one
  • (Pay 5 gold) Take a room at the sailors' inn. GO TO the sailors' inn.
  • Visit the chandler. GO TO the chandler.
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Browse the quayside traders. GO TO the quayside traders.
  • Book passage on a ship. GO TO booking passage.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:45-the-harbour-town:the-quayside-trad.html:
Whatever the ships bring in, from every shore, is sold off the quay before it's dry.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon itemItem value
1x random Rare itemItem value

The traders, with collectors overseas, buy any Rare item at its full value. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:45-the-harbour-town:the-sailors-inn.html: Hammocks, rum, and old salts by the fire who can smell tomorrow's weather. You rest, for 1 curse. Then you may shuffle the weather pile. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:a-handful-of-.html: You're at the cave mouth, pockets heavy, when a coin slides down the hoard behind you with a sound like a bell in an empty church. One golden eye opens, and the cave fills with heat. You gain 8 gold. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:at-the-edge-o.html:
They won't set a paw in the pyramid's shadow, so they come at you in fits and starts, snapping and backing off. Then a thing wrapped in rags climbs the pyramid's stair behind you, with another shuffling up after it, and you understand why.

The Shadow's Edge
Enemy HP: 10 per player
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Raised Bones (#3)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common item, from the rags of the dead.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:circle-the-wa.title: Circle the Wagons
ev:5-offering-curio-market:circle-the-wa.html:
The bandits kick over their stew and grab whatever's closest. The chief doesn't even get up. He just picks another knife.

Circle the Wagons
Enemy HP: 10 + 9 per player
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Ringleader (#12)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Weapon and 2 gold, from the bandits.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won and freed the merchant, GO TO the merchant's wagons. If you won, GO TO the takings. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you won and freed the merchant
If you won

ev:5-offering-curio-market:deaf-to-the-s.html: The song beats against the wax like moths at a window. The singers come out over the surf after you, and can't understand why you aren't smiling. You can't hear a word they sing, and you can't hear each other either. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round, and nobody may speak until the fight is over. GO TO Siren Song.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:5-offering-curio-market:deserts.html:
Jackals have dogged you since noon, never closer than a stone's throw. Then the wind uncovers the tip of a black pyramid, a doorway gaping just below the sand, and the jackals stop dead at the edge of its shadow, and whine.

Choose one
  • Turn on the jackals. GO TO at the edge of the shadow.
  • Go down into the pyramid, where they won't follow. GO TO the pyramid's stair.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:keeping-the-t.html: You load up what you can carry, and drink a toast to the bandits with their own wine. You gain 6 gold, 1x random Uncommon Potion (the best of the wine), 1x random Uncommon Travel item and 1x random Common Weapon. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:5-offering-curio-market:mountains.html:
Smoke curls from a cave high on the slope, in long, slow breaths. Inside, on a hill of gold, sleeps a great fire salamander, longer than a river barge. It's old, and the fire along its back burns low.

Choose one
  • Fill your pockets, and run for it. GO TO a handful of gold.
  • (Everyone adds an Exhaustion to their deck) Pack snow onto its embers while it sleeps. GO TO smothered embers.
  • Strike while it sleeps. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:5-offering-curio-market:oceans.html:
A song drifts across the water, sweeter than anything you've ever heard, and your hands have turned the rudder towards it before you've decided to. Ahead, pale women with seaweed in their hair are singing on a black reef, and the rocks under them are white with bones.

Choose one
  • Stop your ears with wax and rag, and row past the reef in silence. GO TO deaf to the song.
  • Let the song bring you onto the reef, blades ready, and see what the bones are wearing. GO TO the sirens' reef.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:old-fire.title: Old Fire
ev:5-offering-curio-market:old-fire.html:
The salamander uncoils off its hoard, coin pouring from its flanks, and its long tail comes lashing round the cave.

Old Fire
Enemy HP: 13 + 7 per player, or 10 + 5 if you packed snow onto its embers
Enemy
Monstrosity's Head (#48)
Monstrosity's Appendage (#49)
Additional Rules
  • If the Monstrosity's Head damages you, add a Flame to your discard pile.
Outcome
Victory
  • The hoard: 12 gold and 1x random Uncommon Weapon.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:one-of-the-ga.html: The chief looks you up and down, and laughs. “Shackled! Can't die, can't be hanged. You'll do.” You drink with them and sing their songs, and at dawn you ride out with them to meet a caravan. The chief puts you at the front: whoever can't die goes in first. As the caravan comes into sight, the Shackle tightens. +1 curse.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:plains.title: Plains
ev:5-offering-curio-market:plains.html:
A ring of wagons crowns the hill, stolen from half the caravans on the road and chained together into a fort. Inside, around the biggest fire you've seen in weeks, bandits are counting the takings. Their chief passes the time throwing knives at a captive merchant chained to a barrel, and missing him by a little less each time.

Choose one
  • Walk in and ask to join. “I hear the pay's excellent.” GO TO one of the gang.
  • (If there is a Purple character in your party) Slip in after dark, and cut the merchant loose before the fighting starts. GO TO the merchant freed.
  • Attack the camp. GO TO Circle the Wagons.

links.clause: If there is a Purple character in your party) Slip in after dark

ev:5-offering-curio-market:returning-the.html: You leave the wagons where they stand. The villagers will come for what's theirs, and when they do, they'll be telling stories about you instead of the bandits. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:siren-song.title: Siren Song
ev:5-offering-curio-market:siren-song.html:
The singers come down off the rocks and up out of the surf, still singing. The song never stops.

Siren Song
Enemy HP: 7 + 9 per player
Enemy
Witch (#32)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you landed on the reef: 1x random Uncommon item and 6 gold, from the bones.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The reef keeps your raft, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, you push off the reef, and it's a long time before you stop hearing the song. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:5-offering-curio-market:smothered-emb.html: The snow hisses into steam, and the fire along its back dies to a red glow. It wakes slow and half blind. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-front-of-.title: The Front of the Line
ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-front-of-.html:
The bandits whoop and hang back, and you meet the caravan's guards alone: veterans, every one, a wall of shields, and two crossbows on the wagon roof. The gang will come in once the shields are down, and not a moment sooner.

The Front of the Line
Enemy HP: 12 + 7 per player
Enemy
Protector (#23)
Poacher (#4)
Outcome
Victory
  • Your share: 1x random Uncommon Weapon, 1x random Uncommon Armor and 10 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-grave-goo.html: You fill your packs under the queen's stone stare. She doesn't blink. Then the lid of her sarcophagus begins to grind aside. You gain 6 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Mummy Dearest.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-lid-grind.html: You heave the lid aside, and your blades are already falling as the queen sits up in a shower of dust and linen. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Mummy Dearest.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-merchant-.html: You cut his ropes in the dark. He runs for it, shouting the alarm in exactly the wrong direction, and half the camp goes charging off after him. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Circle the Wagons.
At dawn the merchant comes back up the hill with half the village behind him, to claim the wagons. He shakes your hand for a long time, and pays you for your trouble. You gain 4 gold. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-pyramid-s.html:
The stair is trapped, as stairs into pyramids always are. The trick is to use only the steps the last thief didn't. At the bottom lies a burial chamber: painted walls, jars of oil long gone to dust, and grave goods heaped around a sarcophagus carved in the likeness of a queen. Her stone eyes are open.

Choose one
  • Fill your packs with the grave goods. GO TO the grave goods.
  • Open the sarcophagus, and strike before she rises. GO TO the lid grinds aside.
  • (If there is a Black character in your party) Command the queen's servants to fill your packs. GO TO the servants obey.

links.clause: If there is a Black character in your party) Command the queen's servants to fill your packs

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-servants-.html: You speak, and the dead listen. The painted servants step down off the walls, bow, and carry the grave goods to you, jar by jar, while their queen watches from her sarcophagus and says nothing. When your packs are full, they climb back into their paintings. You gain 6 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-sirens-re.html: The raft grinds onto the reef among the bones, and the singers crowd closer, still smiling, still singing. Their teeth are very long. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Siren Song.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-takings.html:
The wagons are stuffed with everything the road has lost this year: bolts of cloth, casks of wine, a harp, a coffin full of spoons.

Choose one
  • (+1 curse) Keep it. GO TO keeping the takings.
  • Leave it for the villagers to recover. GO TO returning the takings.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:5-offering-curio-market:woodlands.html: The evening sunlight plays tricks among the trees, and you nearly miss a brief golden glint at the edge of your vision. GO TO shiny object.

ev:57-emberskitter-nest:bottled-fire.html: What's left of her ichor oozes from the walls, slow and angry. It takes to glass as if it had missed it. You gain Incendiary Flask (Uncommon Potion #3). STOP READING.

ev:57-emberskitter-nest:emberskitter-nes.title: Emberskitter Nest
ev:57-emberskitter-nest:emberskitter-nes.html:
The dunes fall away into a crater, and over it swells a dome of glass, wide as a village.

  • If you came here from Fate or Sealed Fate, read the Fate section below.
  • If you finished The Burning Weald, GO TO the cold nest.
  • If you have any active quest, GO TO the clicking dome.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

The dome is amber, and warm as a kiln. As you come down the slope, the clicking under it stops. The dome splits from rim to crown, and its glowing heart tears loose: a core of molten glass, big as a barrel, that screams over your heads and comes down in the woods like a falling star. The trees go up like tinder. Reach the fire's heart and kill what rode it there, before there's no wood left to save. continue reading.

links.clause: If you finished The Burning Weald
If you have any active quest

ev:57-emberskitter-nest:into-the-smoke.title: Into the Smoke
ev:57-emberskitter-nest:into-the-smoke.html:
The air is hot enough to hurt, and the smoke clicks.

Smoke Beneath the Boughs
Enemy HP: 5 + 10 per player
Enemy
Emberskitter Sack (#26)
Emberskitter (#25)
Additional Rules
  • One more Emberskitter for every 10 curse.
  • At 10 or more curse, enemy HP is 4 + 11 per player; at 20 or more, 20 + 11.
Outcome
Victory
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:57-emberskitter-nest:the-burning-weal.title: The Burning Weald
ev:57-emberskitter-nest:the-burning-weal.html:
Setup
  1. Find the nearest group of connected Woodlands locations. Put a large red cube on the one farthest from you. This cube is the heart of the fire.
  2. Leave the quest bookmark on this page: The Burning Weald is now your active quest, and its effects apply until it ends.
Quest effects
  • When you enter or search the heart of the fire: instead of drawing adventure cards, GO TO The Heart of the Fire
  • When you enter any other location with a red cube: the smoke chokes you. Discard the top 2 adventure cards.
  • When you rest: the fire burns through the night. It spreads twice, as the Fate section says, and at 6 red cubes, GO TO The Fire Wins
Fate (Read this when you play Fate or Sealed Fate)

ev:57-emberskitter-nest:the-clicking-dom.html: The dome clicks and glows, patient as a kiln. Whatever's under it can wait for you. STOP READING.

ev:57-emberskitter-nest:the-cold-nest.html:

ev:6-the-last-customer:counting-the-toll.html: The coins ring on the heap. The guards stoop to count them, joint by clicking joint, and their captain waves you across with a bony hand. By the time they've finished counting, you're long gone. STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:6-the-last-customer:deserts.html:
At the foot of a red mesa, a spring wells up into a pool no bigger than a cart, ringed with date palms. An old woman in a sun-bleached robe sits in the shade with her feet in the water, tracing the same figures in the sand with a stick, over and over: a cut, a parry, a turn. She was a sword-dancer once, and a famous one, to judge by the scars. “Water's free,” she says, without looking up. “Lessons aren't.”

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Take her lessons. GO TO lessons by the spring.
  • (If there is a Purple character in your party) Dance her figures back to her. GO TO the dance remembered.
  • Fill your waterskins, and go on. GO TO water for the road.

links.clause: If there is a Purple character in your party) Dance her figures back to her

ev:6-the-last-customer:helping-yourself.html: The coins are old and cold, and there are a great many of them. Every skull on the bridge turns to watch your hand go into the heap. You gain 6 gold. The fight has two Raised Bones more. GO TO The Old Toll.

ev:6-the-last-customer:in-on-the-current.html: The current brings you in at dusk, slow and easy. As your raft touches the sand, the whole island shivers, as if something had tickled it. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:6-the-last-customer:lessons-by-the-sp.html: She works you until the sun is low, with the stick, and then with steel, and says nothing kind until the very end. Everyone may look through their whole training deck, buy up to 2 cards at their EXP cost, then shuffle it. STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:6-the-last-customer:mountains.html:
A rope bridge spans the ravine. On the far side, a row of skeletons in rusted mail sits beneath a toll board. The painted price has peeled away. As you approach, one raises an empty palm; another points helpfully at a heap of coins below the sign, and beside it, a heap of bones.

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Toss your coins onto the heap below the sign. GO TO counting the toll.
  • Scoop up a fistful of the toll heap on your way past. GO TO helping yourself.
  • Draw your weapons and cross. GO TO The Old Toll.
  • (If there is a Black character in your party) Tell the guards their watch is over. GO TO relieved of duty.

links.clause: If there is a Black character in your party) Tell the guards their watch is over

ev:6-the-last-customer:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:6-the-last-customer:oceans.html:
A little island sits on the horizon, green and quiet, with a stand of palms and the glint of a spring among them. It's the first land you've seen in days, and the current is carrying you past it.

Choose one
  • (Everyone adds an Exhaustion to their deck) Row for it, hard, against the current. GO TO rowing for the island.
  • Let the current carry you round, and come in on the far side at dusk. GO TO in on the current.

ev:6-the-last-customer:plains.title: Plains
ev:6-the-last-customer:plains.html:
Squinting against the evening sun, you spot a plume of smoke billowing near the horizon. As you approach cautiously, the faint sounds of conversation tell you of a trading caravan drafting guard duties for the night. By the tracks in the grass, someone has been following it for days, and keeping well out of sight.

Choose one
  • Approach the traders openly, and offer to stand a watch. “Whoever's following you won't care what I am.” GO TO hired for the night.
  • (If there is a Red character in your party) Follow the tracks back, and meet whoever is following the caravan on ground of your choosing. GO TO ground of your choosing.
  • Wait until dusk, and sneak past the guards to steal the merchant's wares. GO TO Lightened Purses.
  • Ride in while it's light, and rob the caravan at sword point. GO TO Sword and Coin.

links.clause: If there is a Red character in your party) Follow the tracks back

ev:6-the-last-customer:relieved-of-duty.html: The captain listens with his skull tilted, the way the dead do when they hear their own tongue. Then he takes off his helmet, sets it on the heap of coins, and sits down. One by one, his guards lay down their spears and sit beside him, and go still, and fall apart. The toll is nobody's now, and the dead linger a while, glad of someone to talk to. You gain 6 gold. GO TO Speak with the Dead.

ev:6-the-last-customer:rowing-for-the-is.html: You run the raft up the beach by noon, with your arms burning. There's time to drink your fill at the spring, and to drag a sea chest out of the sand, half buried, the last thing left of somebody's wreck. Then the island sneezes, and the beach begins to move. You gain Waterskin (Common Travel #7) and 1x random Common Travel item. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:6-the-last-customer:shell-shock.title: Shell Shock
ev:6-the-last-customer:shell-shock.html:
At the island's edge, a head the size of a boat comes up out of the sea on a long, wrinkled neck, and turns to see what's on its back. Under your feet, the beach heaves like a breathing thing.

Shell Shock
Enemy HP: 10 + 8 per player
Enemy
Monstrosity's Body (#50)
Monstrosity's Head (#48)
Additional Rules
  • Hold out: at the end of round 3, the island dives. If you're still fighting, you win.
Outcome
Victory
  • 5 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The island dives with your raft still on its back, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 7 exp for each player.

If you won, you reach the raft as the island goes under, and it surfaces again a mile away, and swims off with a long, contented groan. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-bear-necessit.title: The Bear Necessities
ev:6-the-last-customer:the-bear-necessit.html:
The bear rears up over the scattered provisions, and the wolves settle down at the edge of the clearing to see who's left when it's over.

The Bear Necessities
Enemy HP: 10 + 9 per player
Enemy
Towering Beast (#6)
Pack Predator (#2)
Outcome
Victory
  • Beast Meat (Common Travel #10) and 4 gold, from what the bear left of the provisions.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-dance-remembe.html: Halfway through, she stands up. By the end, she's dancing with you, stick and all, and laughing like a girl. She won't take a coin for what comes after. Everyone may look through their whole training deck, buy up to 2 cards at their EXP cost, then shuffle it. STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-wolves-go-in.html: The wolves take the call, and go for the bear in a snarling rush, and more of them come out of the trees to join in. The bear holds them off for a while, then gives up its supper, and lumbers away into the trees. When the pack has eaten, its leader brings you the torn pack in its jaws, and drops it at your feet, as if you'd asked for it. You gain Beast Meat (Common Travel #10), 4 gold and 1x random Common Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:water-for-the-roa.html: The water is cold and sweet, and she doesn't mind you taking some. You gain a Waterskin (Common Travel #7). STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:6-the-last-customer:woodlands.html:
A torn pack hangs from a low branch. Beneath it, a bear noses through scattered provisions while wolves wait at a respectful distance. Something useful still bulges inside the canvas, just beyond the bear's reach. Yours, too, unless you leave the cover of the trees.

Choose one
  • Creep in for the torn pack, under the bear's nose. GO TO recover the torn pack.
  • (If there is a Green character in your party) Howl like the pack's leader, and set the wolves on the bear. GO TO the wolves go in.
  • Charge the bear. GO TO The Bear Necessities.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:a-day-s-hunting.html: The huntsmen guide you home at dusk, with a stag slung under a pole. You gain Beast Meat (Common Travel #10). STOP READING.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:an-empty-hall.html: The household is out hunting. A steward presses a cup of cider into your hands without looking up from his ledger. STOP READING.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:at-dawn.html: The hounds sleep in heaps by the fire, and so do you. At dawn the hunt clatters back in, muddy and empty-handed: the old devil gave them the slip. The lord is already roaring for fresh horses. You rest, for 1 curse. STOP READING.

  2. Put a black cube on the Manor: the lord's hunting party, riding out with you.

  • When you enter the lord's location: instead of drawing adventure cards, GO TO By His Fire
  • When you rest: GO TO Horns in the Night

The lord rides on: move the black cube 2 locations along the shortest way to the Old Grizzly, by road if one leads there, or else ignoring roads. Skip numbered locations: he rides straight through them without counting them. If it reaches the Old Grizzly, GO TO Second to the Kill If it enters your location on the way, GO TO By His Fire Otherwise, read the page equal to your curse, as usual.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:the-hunting-mano.title: The Hunting Manor
ev:61-the-hunting-manor:the-hunting-mano.html:
• If you came here from Fate or Sealed Fate, read the Fate section below.
  • If you finished The Great Hunt, GO TO the lord's guests.
  • If your active quest is The Haul Home, GO TO To the Lord's Table.
  • If you have any other active quest, GO TO an empty hall.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

You hear the manor long before you see it: horns, hooves, and a hundred hounds baying at once. Its lord meets you in the yard, a big, happy man in a hunting coat, with his whole household saddling up behind him: huntsmen, beaters, a guide, and hounds past counting. “The Old Grizzly's been seen in the deep woods!” he roars. “Ride with us, friends! A race, mind: first to the bear has him, and I shan't wait for you.”

Choose one
  • “Could we set out tomorrow?” GO TO tomorrow.
  • Wish him luck, and leave. STOP READING.
  • Join the hunt. Continue reading.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:the-lord-s-guest.html:
The Old Grizzly's hide hangs over the lord's fireplace, and he tells the story of the hunt to anyone who'll listen, a little better every time.

Choose one
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Ride out with his huntsmen. GO TO a day's hunting.
  • (Rest, for 1 curse) Sleep in his hall. GO TO the lord's hall.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:the-lord-s-hall.html: The hounds sleep in heaps by the fire, and so do you. You rest, for 1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:61-the-hunting-manor:tomorrow.html:
He laughs until his horse shies. “Tomorrow! By tomorrow that bear's hide will be on my wall. But sleep in my hall by all means, if your legs won't carry you.”

Choose one
  • “Fine, fine: we'll ride with you.” GO TO The Great Hunt.
  • (Rest, for 1 curse) Sleep in his hall, and join the next hunt tomorrow. GO TO at dawn.

• If you came here from Fate or Sealed Fate, read the Fate section below.

You smell Saltwind before you see it: tar, fish and seaweed, on a wind that has wrecked countless ships against its cliffs. The town tumbles down the rock in steps and ladders, its roofs weighed down with stones against the gales, to a harbour so full of masts it looks like a winter wood.

You're barely through the gate when an old cartographer unrolls a map under your nose. “A captain's hoard,” he swears, tapping a cross at the very edge of the world. “As far from here as dry land goes. No hurry: it's waited two hundred years.” Asked which way is north, he waves at the compass rose. “Decorative, mostly.”

Choose one
  • Wave him off. GO TO the harbour.
  • (Pay 10 gold) Buy his map. Continue reading.

ev:64-saltwind:the-drowned-man.html: The beds smell of rum, and the wind howls all night against the shutters, but it doesn't get in. You rest, for 1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:64-saltwind:the-harbour.html:
Saltwind gets on with its business. Down on the quays, crews load and curse and mend their nets, and every ship in the harbour is bound somewhere, most of them willing to take passengers. Between the warehouses, a general store sells whatever a traveller "forgot", and above it all leans the Drowned Man, an inn with walls thick enough to keep out the wind.

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Take rooms at the Drowned Man. GO TO the Drowned Man.
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Browse the general store. GO TO the harbour store.
  • Book passage on a ship. GO TO booking passage.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:64-saltwind:the-wrong-way-up.title: The Wrong Way Up
ev:64-saltwind:the-wrong-way-up.html:
You stop to check the map against a landmark, and the landmark is on the wrong side. You turn the map round. Then all the way round. The cartographer's cross, it turns out, was never where you thought. Spin the weather vane again, and follow the arrow's line from the vane to the edge of the map. Move the large yellow cube to the land location without a number on it farthest out along that line. If there's no land along it, spin again.

Then read the page equal to your curse.

ev:69-the-crooked-spire:the-crooked-spir.title: The Crooked Spire
ev:69-the-crooked-spire:the-crooked-spir.html:
The road climbs into the mountains, ending at the foot of a tower that leans over it at an angle that makes your neck ache in sympathy.

  • If you came here from Fate or Sealed Fate, read the Fate section below.
  • If you finished Neither Here nor There, or you have any active quest, GO TO the Magister's parlour.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

Its door opens before you can knock, on a thin old man in a dressing gown embroidered with stars. “Shackled visitors! Marvellous. Nothing interesting has happened here since Pip left.” This is Magister Crane, and the kettle is already on.

“Pip,” he sighs over the second cup. “My frog, a little experiment in being elsewhere. She got out forty years ago, and she's been blinking all over the world ever since. Bring her home, and I'll make it worth your while. She likes fairy rings and farms.”

Choose one
  • Thank him for the tea, and decline. GO TO the Magister's parlour.
  • Promise to bring her home. Continue reading.

links.clause: If you finished Neither Here nor There

ev:69-the-crooked-spire:the-magister-s-p.html:
The kettle is always on, and the parlour is full of clocks that disagree and doors leaning against each other. The Magister will do almost anything for gold.

Choose one
  • (Pay 8 gold) Ask for a door to somewhere else. GO TO a door.
  • (Pay 2 gold) Order some weather. GO TO weather to order.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:69-the-crooked-spire:weather-to-order.html: He opens the window and shouts at the sky. It grumbles, and does as it's told. Play a weather of your choice. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:caught-in-the-door.html: Behind you, the slide roars down into the quarry, and takes the miner and her song with it. Ahead, the troll is wedged in its own doorway, still half asleep. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Cold Shoulder.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:cold-shoulder.title: Cold Shoulder
ev:7-traders-miners-m:cold-shoulder.html:
The cave it slept in was very cold, and very quiet, and it would like to know who's responsible. Frost walks out at its heels, on a great many small, sharp legs.

Cold Shoulder
Enemy HP: 11 per player
Enemy
Rimelings (#35)
Ice Troll (#7)
Outcome
Victory
  • 8 gold, from the silver vein the slide laid bare.
  • If the miner lives, she leads you out by the miners' paths: you may move up to 2 locations through Mountains.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:7-traders-miners-m:deserts.html:
The wind has scoured the salt flat clean of everything but a brass lamp, half buried and polished to a mirror shine by centuries of sand. When you kneel beside it, it's warm, far warmer than the sun could make it. From inside comes a low hum, the kind of tune someone hums when they've been waiting a very long time and have given up on company. Around its base, in a script older than any kingdom, runs a line that will be familiar to anyone who has ever signed a contract: “Here waits Imsar, who grants what is asked of him, for as long as he is bound.”

Carefully, you rub the lamp. GO TO rub the lamp.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:dragged-clear.html: You reach her as the slope comes down, and the two of you go tumbling with it, battered, bruised and alive. When you dig yourselves out, the thing from the cave is coming down the rubble towards you. One of you adds an Exhaustion to their deck. GO TO Cold Shoulder.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:laid-to-rest.html: The words come to you as if someone had been waiting to hear them. The knocking stops in coffin after coffin, and they sink, one by one, wreaths, grave goods and all. Not all of them. The fight has one Raised Bones fewer. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:lost-and-found.title: Lost and Found
ev:7-traders-miners-m:lost-and-found.html:
The stump unfolds into something small and bark-skinned, with a great many knees, and hops out of reach. It waggles its fingers, and frogs come blinking out of the moss, in and out around you like rain on a pond.

Lost and Found
Enemy HP: 8 + 9 per player
Enemy
Warpfrog (#31)
Mage (#39)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Travel item, from the packs of travellers who never found the way out.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, the trees stop moving: you may move to any adjacent location. STOP READING. If you lost, move to a random adjacent location, up to 3 times, stopping as soon as you're out of the Woodlands. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:7-traders-miners-m:mountains.html:
A stocky miner is singing at the lip of a quarry, hauling ore out of the pit on a pulley. You hail her, and she startles; the rope slips, and the bundle drops into the pit with a crash that echoes for far too long. Then the whole slope above you begins to move.

The miner stands frozen in the slide's path. Higher up, where the rock has split open like a log, something huge and grey is climbing out of the dark, blinking at the light.

Choose one
  • Run to the miner, and drag her out of the slide's path. GO TO dragged clear.
  • Run for the cave mouth, and catch the thing before it's all the way out. GO TO caught in the doorway.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:7-traders-miners-m:oceans.html:
A cluster of wooden coffins drifts across your course. Each bears a little wreath of salt-stiffened flowers. You reach for something to push them clear, then pause. Against the slap of the waves, you think you hear knocking.

Choose one
  • (If there is a Gold character in your party) Say a prayer over them, with the words their mourners left unsaid. GO TO laid to rest.
  • Pry the lids, and rob the dead before they're up. GO TO the lids pried.
  • Push them clear with the oars, and meet whatever climbs out. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

links.clause: If there is a Gold character in your party) Say a prayer over them

ev:7-traders-miners-m:one-step.html: It takes your payment with a little shiver of delight, and keeps its word. The trees lean aside, and paths open that weren't there a moment ago, leading out of the woods wherever you like. You and your allies may move through Woodlands as many locations as you like, then out to any location adjacent to them. STOP READING.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:plains.title: Plains
ev:7-traders-miners-m:plains.html:
At dusk, a column of pilgrims crests the hill and comes down the road towards you, walking two by two in perfect silence. They carry candles that give no light, and little painted icons of a goddess you know well: Adrai'lalth, the Healer. Their robes are rags and their feet are bare. So are their bones. At the head of the column, a tall figure swaddled in grey thread counts the beads of a rosary made of knuckles.

Hundreds of empty sockets pass you by without a glance. The dead are on their way to be healed. The column is long: if you fight it here on the road, the fight has one Raised Bones more.

Choose one
  • Hold your breath, and fall in line with the pilgrims. “They're going my way.” GO TO Walking With the Dead.
  • Draw your weapons. “Somebody has to tell them.” GO TO Pale Ambush.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-lids-pried.html: Rings, coins for the ferryman, a silver locket. You're elbow deep in the third coffin when the hands inside start to grab back. You gain 1x random Uncommon item and 6 gold. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:the-stump-flustere.html: “Not lost at all,” you tell it, “and thank you for asking,” which is the right answer, and it knows it. It stamps its roots in a temper. It won't show you the way now, and it's so flustered that its tricks come out all wrong. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO Lost and Found.

ev:7-traders-miners-m:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:7-traders-miners-m:woodlands.html:
The trees all look the same. Then they all look like the same tree. You've passed that mossy stump three times now, and the third time, it speaks. “Lost?” it creaks. “I know the way out. It'll cost you, though: just a little piece of your soul.”

Choose one
  • Tell it you're not lost, as the old stories say you must. GO TO the stump flustered.
  • (+1 curse) Pay its price. GO TO one step.
  • Draw your weapons on the stump. GO TO Lost and Found.

ev:73-bone-weaver-s-barrow:bone-weaver-s.title: Bone Weaver's Barrow
ev:73-bone-weaver-s-barrow:bone-weaver-s.html:
The barrow rises out of the grass like the shoulder of a sleeping giant. An old king sleeps under it, and the towns nearby still carry his blood.

  • If you came here from Fate or Sealed Fate, read the Fate section below.
  • If you finished The Sleepwalkers, GO TO the quiet barrow.
  • If your active quest is The Sleepwalkers and no white cubes are left on the map, GO TO A Bone to Pick.
  • If you have any active quest, GO TO the humming hill.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

The slab over its door stands open a crack, and from under the hill comes a humming, patient and tuneless. A girl of six or seven walks past you, barefoot in her nightshirt, eyes shut, humming along, heading for the door.

Choose one
  • Leave. STOP READING.
  • Wake her. Continue reading.

links.clause: If you finished The Sleepwalkers
If your active quest is The Sleepwalkers and no white cubes are left on the map
If you have any active quest

ev:73-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-humming-h.html: The humming goes on under the hill, and the slab over the door won't move any further. STOP READING.

ev:73-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-quiet-bar.html: The barrow is only a tomb again. Nothing hums under the hill, and the grass between the stones has begun to stand up. STOP READING.

ev:73-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-sleepwalk.title: The Sleepwalkers
ev:73-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-sleepwalk.html:
She wakes screaming, and clings to you. Someone was singing, she says, beckoning her, and her cousins heard it too. Under the hill, the humming falters, then starts again, further off: it has other children to call. Find them before they reach the door.

Setup
  1. Put a white cube on 3 locations that are each 3 locations from you along the shortest way, as far apart from each other as you can: the children of the king's blood, walking in their sleep.
  2. Leave the quest bookmark on this page: The Sleepwalkers is now your active quest, and its effects apply until it ends.
Quest effects
  • When you enter or search a location with a white cube: instead of drawing adventure cards or reading a town's page, GO TO wide awake
  • When you rest: the children walk all night. Move every white cube to the Barrow, and turn it black (put a black cube in its place). Then GO TO The Hill Opens

You may abandon this quest at any time.

Fate (Read this when you play Fate or Sealed Fate)

The children walk: move every white cube 1 location along the shortest way to the Barrow, even one on your location. A child that reaches the Barrow turns black: put a black cube in its place. If no white cubes are left, GO TO The Hill Opens Otherwise, read the page equal to your curse, as usual.

After setting up the quest, STOP READING.

links.clause: If no white cubes are left

You catch a small hand, and the humming stops: a gasp, a sob, and a child who wants to go home. Remove this white cube. Everyone gains 1 EXP. If no white cubes are left on the map, GO TO The Hill Opens If there are, STOP READING.

ev:77-the-humming-vault:cause-for-alarm.title: Cause for Alarm
ev:77-the-humming-vault:cause-for-alarm.html:
The copper arms scream as they let go, and the guardians' heads turn towards you, one by one. You run. You're out of the door and halfway down the slope when every lamp behind you turns red. Bells ring in the rock, the hum climbs to a scream, and out of the dark pour brass things on whirring wings, trailing sparks. Somewhere far below, something begins to count. Get well clear of the mountain before it's done. You gain Arc Coil (Unique Armor #7). Everyone gains 6 EXP.

Setup
  1. Leave the quest bookmark on this page: Cause for Alarm is now your active quest, and its effects apply until it ends.
Quest effects
  • When you rest: if you're more than 3 leagues from the Vault, GO TO Out of Range If not, GO TO The Blast in the Night
Fate (Read this when you play Fate or Sealed Fate)

The count goes on: put a red cube on the Vault. Then:

  • If that makes 3, and you're more than 3 leagues from the Vault: GO TO Out of Range
  • If that makes 3, and you're 3 leagues or less from the Vault: GO TO Countdown
  • Otherwise, 3 leagues or less from the Vault: GO TO Hot Pursuit
  • Otherwise: read the page equal to your curse, as usual.

After setting up the quest, STOP READING.

links.clause: if you're more than 3 leagues from the Vault

ev:77-the-humming-vault:the-humming-vaul.title: The Humming Vault
ev:77-the-humming-vault:the-humming-vaul.html:
Where the plain breaks against the mountains, a round door of green bronze is set into the rock, taller than a barn and without a handle.

  • If you came here from Fate or Sealed Fate, read the Fate section below.
  • If you finished Cause for Alarm, GO TO the tinkerer.
  • If you have any active quest, GO TO the sealed door.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

The door hums, low enough to feel in your teeth. Shepherds keep their flocks well away: behind it, they say, the ancients' machines still keep watch.

Choose one
  • Leave. STOP READING.
  • Work out the seal. Continue reading.

The rings turn under your hands, and the door rolls aside on a hall of brass and dark glass. Nothing moves. At the bottom of the stairs, an engine the size of a mill turns in a cage of lightning, its guardians standing dead still around it. And at its heart, in a cradle of copper arms, rests a gauntlet of coiled wire, crackling with a captured storm. It's close enough to reach.

Choose one
  • Leave it, and back out the way you came. STOP READING.
  • Tear it from the engine. Continue reading.

links.clause: If you finished Cause for Alarm
If you have any active quest

ev:77-the-humming-vault:the-sealed-door.html: The door hums behind its seal of turning rings, and they won't turn for you today. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:8-knight-errant:deserts.html:
At noon, you reach a ruined temple half swallowed by the dunes. Its mirrors, still polished after who knows how many centuries, catch the sun and pour it onto the altar, where a disc of gold burns too bright to look at. Before it kneels something in a priest's robes. It has been kneeling for a very long time.

Choose one
  • Turn the mirrors away from the altar. GO TO the temple goes dim.
  • (+1 curse) Take the golden disc. GO TO the sun's price.
  • Wake the priest. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:8-knight-errant:eye-of-the-storm.title: Eye of the Storm
ev:8-knight-errant:eye-of-the-storm.html:
The drones peel away from the mast and dive at you, crackling, and the machine swings its mast round to follow you, and calls the lightning down.

Eye of the Storm
Enemy HP: 12 per player
Enemy
Storm Engine (#38)
Arc Drone (#44)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon, from the scorched rocks around the machine.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, the machine sputters, and dies. STOP READING. If you lost, you come to on the bare rock, with the machine still humming above you. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:knight-errant.title: Knight Errant
ev:8-knight-errant:knight-errant.html:
The knight sighs, lowers his visor, and whistles. “Then I must insist.” Three squires come running from behind a hedge with their shields up, rather more of them than a knight strictly needs.

Knight Errant
Enemy HP: 10 + 9 per player
Enemy
Knight (#45)
Protector (#23)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:8-knight-errant:mountains.html:
On a bare headland, a brass machine the size of a cart squats among the rocks, humming, with a copper mast pointed at the sky. Two little brass drones circle the mast, feeding it sparks, and above it the clouds turn in a slow circle, black and crackling: the machine is making a storm. Whoever built it is long gone, and it has been running ever since. The weather turns to Thunderstorm: put it on top of the weather pile.

Choose one
  • (If there is a Blue character in your party, they add 2 Exhaustion to their deck) Take hold of the storm, and pull it apart faster than the machine can feed it. GO TO the storm tamed.
  • Break the machine. GO TO Eye of the Storm.

links.clause: If there is a Blue character in your party

ev:8-knight-errant:nature-s-wrath.title: Nature's Wrath
ev:8-knight-errant:nature-s-wrath.html:
The eldest raises her staff, and the forest answers. The wolves rise, and more come padding out of the trees at her call.

Nature's Wrath
Enemy HP: 13 + 8 per player
Enemy
Convoker (#15)
Pack Predator (#2)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you took the offerings: 12 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • If you took the offerings: +1 curse. If you asked for the blessing, it was only a test, and losing costs no curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won and asked for the blessing, GO TO the druids' blessing. Otherwise, STOP READING.

links.clause: If you won and asked for the blessing

ev:8-knight-errant:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:8-knight-errant:oceans.html:
A fat merchant galley drifts alongside, oars shipped, and its purser leans over the rail with a ledger. “Water, biscuit, rope, charts. Everything a raft could want. Prices are what they are: you're a long way from the nearest market.”

ItemPrice
Beast Meat (Common Travel #10)4 gold
Compass (Common Travel #3)6 gold
Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1)30 gold

The galley's master leans on the rail beside him. “If you're handy with a blade, I'll pay you to clear the rats out of my hold. They're into the biscuit.”

Once you're done trading:

Choose one
  • Go down into the hold after the rats. GO TO the rats in the hold.
  • Climb aboard, and take what you want without paying. GO TO over the rail.
  • Push off, and sail on. GO TO another day at sea.

ev:8-knight-errant:over-the-rail.html: You're over the rail before the purser has finished his sums, and into his strongroom before the master has finished shouting. Your hand closes on the strongbox, and the Shackle tightens. +1 curse. GO TO Rough Trade.

ev:8-knight-errant:plains.title: Plains
ev:8-knight-errant:plains.html:
A knight in dented armor blocks the road, visor up, lance at rest. “Good morrow! I have sworn to cross swords with one Shackled every day, in fair and honorable combat, and I'm afraid you're today's.” He sounds genuinely apologetic. “I must insist, you understand. It's a vow.”

Choose one
  • Accept his challenge: one of you will face him alone. GO TO a duel.
  • Refuse. GO TO Knight Errant.

links.clause: If you lost

ev:8-knight-errant:rough-trade.title: Rough Trade
ev:8-knight-errant:rough-trade.html:
The galley's crew, it turns out, are sailors who've been to a few ports rougher than you.

Rough Trade
Enemy HP: 13 + 8 per player
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Ranger (#24)
Outcome
Victory
  • Compass (Common Travel #3), 2x Beast Meat (Common Travel #10) and 8 gold, from the purser's strongroom.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, the galley rows off in a hurry. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, you spend a day chained to an oar before the master decides the Shackled are more trouble than they're worth, and throws you off at the nearest shore: move to the nearest land location. GO TO successful landing.

ev:8-knight-errant:sunstroke.html:
The priest raises its hands, and the light from the mirrors bends to it. Out of the sand around the altar climb the temple's servants, who polished the mirrors in life, and polish them still, burnt black and smoking.

Sunstroke
Enemy HP: 13 + 8 per player
Enemy
Soot Biter (#5)
Mage (#39)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon item, from the priest's robes.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-druids-blessing.html: The eldest lays a hand on your brow, and the forest seems to lean closer, and show you things. Everyone gains 4 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-rats-in-the-hold.html: The hold is dark, and it stinks, and something in it is chewing. Then your lamp finds the rats, and you see why the master didn't go down himself: they're the size of dogs, and there are more of them in the bilge. GO TO Rat Race.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-storm-tamed.html: It fights you all afternoon, and you feel every bolt of it in your bones. By evening the clouds have come apart into rags, and the machine is whining and sputtering, with nothing left to feed. The drones settle on its mast, and go dark. The weather turns to Clear Skies: put it on top of the weather pile. Everyone gains 4 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-sun-s-price.html: The disc is heavy, and hot, and worth a fortune. The priest stands up as it leaves the altar, and the sun seems to follow you, lower and hotter than it should be. You gain 25 gold. Play Smoldering Heat. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:8-knight-errant:the-temple-goes-dim.html: The mirrors grind round on their pivots, and the temple goes dim and cool. Its dead servants, who know only the light, stumble in the dark, and after the glare outside, so do you. The fight has one Soot Biter fewer, and each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:8-knight-errant:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:8-knight-errant:woodlands.html:
The path ends at a ring of standing stones, older than the trees around them, with a fire in the middle that doesn't seem to need wood. Robed figures turn to watch you come, and the wolves lying at their feet lift their heads. At the foot of the stones, the offerings of a hundred years are heaped: coins, rings, carved charms.

Choose one
  • Ask for the druids' blessing. “The forest blesses those it has tested,” says the eldest. GO TO Nature's Wrath.
  • (+1 curse) Take the offerings. GO TO Nature's Wrath.

ev:80-the-marshal-s-camp:a-bunk.html: Straw, a blanket, a sentry outside all night, and the soldiers' snoring for a lullaby. You rest, for 1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:80-the-marshal-s-camp:the-camp.html:
The camp goes about its business. Off-duty soldiers rent out their bunks to anyone with coin, and behind the smithy, the quartermaster keeps a tent of spare kit he'd rather not count too closely.

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Rent a bunk. GO TO a bunk.
  • Browse the quartermaster's tent. GO TO the quartermaster.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:80-the-marshal-s-camp:the-marshal-s-c.title: The Marshal's Camp
ev:80-the-marshal-s-camp:the-marshal-s-c.html:
• If you finished this quest, GO TO the camp at ease.
  • If you have a different active quest, GO TO the camp.
  • If this is your active quest, GO TO the camp.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

Rows of tents as straight as a ruler, cook-fires, and the clang of a smith's hammer. On the plain beyond, a whole regiment marches, wheels and marches back, while a sergeant bawls at it. A marshal has camped his army here to hunt down the warband that's been burning the villages round about, and his sentries take one look at you and wave you in: he takes anyone who can fight.

The marshal is younger than you expected, and very tired. “Four bands,” he says, sweeping tokens across his sand table, “spread across the province, burning as they go. I'm hopelessly short of captains. You can have three companies. Bring me their banner.”

Choose one
  • Not today. GO TO the camp.
  • Take the commission. Continue reading.

The bands march on whatever company is nearest, his officers explain, and a company that falls on a band breaks it, if its captain can bring it there in time. Your companies march only on your orders.

Setup
  1. Put 4 black cubes , the bands, on 4 locations of your choice on your landmass, each at least 3 leagues from you. If there aren't 4 that far, use the farthest.
  2. Put 3 white cubes , your companies, on 3 other locations of your choice on your landmass, each not adjacent to you. Measure in leagues, roads or not. Cubes never leave the landmass.
  3. Leave the quest bookmark on this page: this is now your active quest. The following effects apply until you abandon or finish it.
Quest effects
  • To rally, at any time but in a fight: discard the top 4 adventure cards, and move a company 1 location towards you. If it moves into a band's location, it destroys one band there.
  • When you enter or search a band's location, or a band enters yours: instead of drawing adventure cards, GO TO Skirmish

To abandon the quest at any time, GO TO Abandoning.

Quest progress

The quest advances each time you shuffle the adventure deck, for any reason. When it advances, each band marches 1 location towards its nearest company; where there's a choice, you choose. A band that enters a company's location destroys the company.

  • When the last band is destroyed: GO TO The Banner Falls
  • When the last company is destroyed: GO TO The Warlord's Host

After setting up the quest, STOP READING.

ev:87-the-rookery:a-respectable-inn.html: Clean sheets, hot water and a locked door. You rest, for 1 curse. STOP READING.

ev:87-the-rookery:the-city.html:
The terraces keep their lamps lit and their streets swept, and a respectable inn faces the cathedral. Down in the old quarter, behind a door with no handle, the masks' market trades in whatever the crown would rather it didn't.

Choose one
  • (Pay 4 gold) Take rooms at the respectable inn. GO TO a respectable inn.
  • (Discard the top 4 adventure cards) Go down into the masks' market. GO TO the market.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:87-the-rookery:the-rookery.title: The Rookery
ev:87-the-rookery:the-rookery.html:
• If you finished this quest, GO TO the city.
  • If you have a different active quest, GO TO the city.
  • If this is your active quest, GO TO the city.
  • If none of the above apply, continue reading.

The city climbs the foot of the mountains in clean stone terraces: guildhalls, a cathedral, a garrison with polished gates, and lamps on every corner. Merchants nod to you; the watch does not. Below the terraces, the old quarter huddles under its own smoke: the Rookery, a thieves' market where everyone wears a mask.

A boy in a fox mask falls into step beside you. His mistress has work for travellers the city's guards don't know, he whispers, and she pays well. He leads you down cellar steps to a woman in a silver mask, among her ledgers. She puts a small box on the table, heavy and sealed with silver wax.

“A smuggling job,” she says. “Carry this to my buyer, in a town far down the road, past the crown's patrols. The buyer pays on delivery. Don't open it, don't lose it, and don't get caught.”

Choose one
  • Turn her down. GO TO the city.
  • Take the job. Continue reading.

Somebody has already tipped off the crown's guards: by the time you're back in the street, there's a patrol on every road out of the city, and each one you meet, you'll have to bribe or fight.

Setup
  1. Put a large white cube on the nearest town at least 4 leagues from you: the buyer. If there's none, use the town farthest from you.
  2. Lay the ruler from you to the buyer, and put a black cube on the location nearest the ruler a third of the way along, and another two thirds of the way along. The black cubes are guards.
  3. Leave the quest bookmark on this page: this is now your active quest. The following effects apply until you abandon or finish it.
Quest effects
  • When you enter a guard's location, or a guard enters yours: instead of drawing adventure cards, GO TO Halt!
  • When you enter or search the buyer's town: instead of drawing adventure cards, GO TO Signed, Sealed, Delivered

To abandon the quest at any time, GO TO Abandoning.

Quest progress

The quest advances each time you shuffle the adventure deck, for any reason. When it advances, the guards patrol: spin the weather vane. The guard nearest you comes 1 location towards you; every other guard patrols to the adjacent location that lies most nearly the arrow's way. Where there's a choice, you choose.

After setting up the quest, STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:a-pocketful-of-.html: You fill your pockets, then your boots, then your hat. You're halfway back up the cliff when the sun goes dark again, and it doesn't come back. You gain 12 gold. Each player draws 1 fewer card in the fight's first round. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:a-voice-they-tr.html: He's their bosun, it turns out, and they know his voice. They turn back for the wreckage, and hold on to that instead. The bosun rides out the storm on your raft, and spends the night showing you how a sailor keeps his feet on a deck that won't hold still. At dawn, he pays his passage from a purse he swam with. Everyone gains 3 EXP. You gain 3 gold. GO TO the storm passes.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:avoiding-the-tr.html: It takes you most of the morning, but you find them: the jaws of a bear trap under the leaves by the chest, and crossbowmen settling into the branches above it, waiting for the snap. Nobody sets a bear trap by a chest for bears. You step round it, and go up after them. GO TO Bait and Switch.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:bait-and-switch.title: Bait and Switch
ev:9-procession-of-bones:bait-and-switch.html:
Crossbows creak in the trees around the chest. You don't see the one with the knife until she's already sitting on the chest, cleaning her nails with it.

Bait and Switch
Enemy HP: 11 + 9 per player
Enemy
Assassin (#42)
Poacher (#4)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Weapon and 2 gold, from the crossbowmen.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO Opening a common chest. If you lost, you wake in the leaves, and the chest is gone. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you won

ev:9-procession-of-bones:booby-trapped-c.html:
You hack through the undergrowth towards the chest, and something under the leaves goes click. Spin the weather vane:

VaneThe trap
N, NE, NW, E, WGO TO caught in the trap
SE, SW, SThe jaws of a bear trap snap shut an inch from your boot. The branches above you rustle: whoever set it has heard it go off. GO TO Bait and Switch

SE, SW, S

ev:9-procession-of-bones:caught-in-the-t.html: THWACK! A jolt of burning pain shoots up from your calf. You look down to find the wicked teeth of a bear trap deeply embedded in your leg. It takes the rest of the day to prise the jaws apart and bind the wound, and you're still at it when the branches above you rustle. Whoever set the trap has come to see what it caught. Discard the top 8 cards of the adventure deck. GO TO Bait and Switch.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:9-procession-of-bones:deserts.html:
From the canyon's rim, you can see the valley floor glitter: diamonds, rubies, gems the size of eggs, scattered like gravel among bones the size of houses. High above the valley, a bird is circling, so big that the sun goes dark each time it passes: a Roc, watching over its larder.

Choose one
  • Climb down and fill your pockets. GO TO a pocketful of jewels.
  • (Lose a Beast Meat) Throw the meat down among the jewels for them to stick to, and follow the Roc when it carries it up to its nest. GO TO the merchants' trick.
  • Wait on the rim with your blades ready, and let it come to you. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:digging-out-the.html: By noon the pass is open, your arms are dead, and the prospectors are in a generous mood. GO TO the prospectors' blanket.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:lightening-the-.html: The prospectors see your blades come out, and reach for their picks. They've dug all season for that gold, and they won't hand it over. As you step in, the Shackle tightens. +1 curse. GO TO Pick Your Battles.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:9-procession-of-bones:mountains.html:
A mule train of prospectors is camped below a pass, waiting for the snow on it to clear. Their saddlebags are full of the gold they dug up this season, so they're selling off their gear to lighten the load.

Choose one
  • (Someone adds an Exhaustion to their deck) Help them dig out the pass first. GO TO digging out the pass.
  • Browse the blanket. GO TO the prospectors' blanket.
  • Draw your blade. You'll help lighten the load of gold instead. GO TO lightening the load.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:9-procession-of-bones:oceans.html:
The sky turns green, then black. The first wave to break over the raft is warm; the second is ice-cold, and takes half your supplies with it. Through the spray, a raider's galley is going down, and its crew is swimming for the only thing still afloat: your raft. There isn't room for all of them, and they know it.

Choose one
  • Haul the first one aboard, and let him talk the others down. GO TO a voice they trust.
  • Fight them off. GO TO Overboard.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:overboard.title: Overboard
ev:9-procession-of-bones:overboard.html:
They come over the side with the sea streaming off them, and nothing left to lose. Their captain comes last, an axe in each hand.

Overboard
Enemy HP: 11 + 9 per player
Enemy
Marauder (#41)
Bandit (#1)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x Hatchet (Common Weapon #2): the captain's axes.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • They take the raft, and leave you to the sea.
  • 6 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the storm passes. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

links.clause: If you won
If you lost

ev:9-procession-of-bones:plains.title: Plains
ev:9-procession-of-bones:plains.html:
Hunting horns sound across the grassland, and a party of riders crests the hill: a baron in green velvet, with his huntsmen and his guards. He reins in, looks you over, and brightens. “Shackled! Splendid. The deer were getting predictable.”

Choose one
  • Run for the high grass, and make the hounds lose your scent. GO TO the scent lost.
  • Stand and fight. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.
  • (If there is a Red character in your party) Let them spread out to hunt you, then turn on them one at a time. GO TO the hunters hunted.

links.clause: If there is a Red character in your party) Let them spread out to hunt you

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-hunters-hun.html: You go to ground in the high grass and wait while the huntsmen fan out. They spread too thin, and you come at them from behind, one by one, until the baron's guards are the only ones left standing round him. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-merchants-t.html: The meat lands among the jewels, and they stick to its fat like flies. Before long the Roc drops out of the sky, seizes the meat and carries it off to its nest on the canyon's rim, a short climb from where you stand. You're there before it has finished its first mouthful. Each player draws 2 more cards in the fight's first round. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-most-danger.title: The Most Dangerous Game
ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-most-danger.html:
The baron blows his horn, and his huntsmen spread out through the grass while his guards close in, laughing.

The Most Dangerous Game
Enemy HP: 13 + 9 per player
Enemy
Royal Guard (#30)
Poacher (#4)
Outcome
Victory
  • Unless you hid in the high grass, the baron flees, and leaves his purse behind: 4 gold.
  • 1x random Common Weapon.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-prospectors.html:
Picks, rope, lamps, and a hatchet or two, spread out on a blanket. If you dug out the pass, every price is half, rounded up.

ItemPrice
3x random Common Travel itemItem value
2x random Common WeaponItem value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemItem value

The prospectors buy any item for half its value, rounded down. Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-scent-lost.html: You crawl through the grass until the hounds are baying at nothing, and the huntsmen with them. Only the baron's guards find you, and they're out of breath. The baron watches from the hill, and keeps his purse well out of reach. The fight has one Poacher fewer. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-storm-passe.html: The storm blows itself out in the night, and drags you a long way with it. GO TO adrift.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-valley-of-j.title: The Valley of Jewels
ev:9-procession-of-bones:the-valley-of-j.html:
The Roc comes down like a falling cliff, and something lean and spotted lopes out from among the bones after it, to eat whatever it leaves.

The Valley of Jewels
Enemy HP: 8 + 11 per player
Enemy
Roc (#9)
Ravenous Beast (#46)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you threw down the meat: 7 gold, picked from the fat.
  • 1x random Uncommon Travel item, from the bones of the last jewel-hunters.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:9-procession-of-bones:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:9-procession-of-bones:woodlands.html:
Tucked away beneath thick foliage, you notice the hard wooden edge of a chest. Though you can't make it out in its entirety behind the leaves, it appears sturdy and unspoiled by rot. It's also the only thing in the clearing that the leaves haven't buried, as if someone wanted it found.

Choose one
  • Hack a path straight to the chest. GO TO Booby trapped chest.
  • (Discard the top 3 adventure cards) Circle the clearing slowly, and look for whoever left it. GO TO avoiding the trap.

ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:a-ship-of-your.title: A Ship of Your Own
ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:a-ship-of-your.html: Sound timbers, a full set of sails, a hull that answers the helm like a horse that knows the road, and nobody aboard to tell you where to go. GO TO at the helm.

ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:at-the-helm.html:
The deck is yours, and so is the sea.

Choose one
  • Sail on. GO TO under sail.
  • (+1 curse) Rest in the captain's cabin. GO TO the captain's cabin.
  • Drop anchor, and row ashore. GO TO rowing ashore.

ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:holed.html: Rocks no chart shows. The hull opens like a book, and the sea pours in. You get the ship's boat over the side as she goes down, and watch her go. You're at sea in this sector, on your own. GO TO another day at sea.

ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:rowing-ashore.html: You row away, and don't look back. By morning, someone else will have found a use for her. Move to any land location in your sector, or up a landing that reaches your sector, to the land location it leads to. STOP READING.

ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:the-captain-s-.html: A real bed, a lamp that swings with the swell, and a very good bottle in the captain's locker. Rest. When you've rested, GO TO at the helm.

ev:aux-a-ship-of-your-own:trouble-at-the.html:
Spin the weather vane:

VaneTrouble
N, NESomething long and grey follows in your wake for a day, then loses interest. GO TO at the helm
NW, E, WA squall comes out of nowhere, and blows you off course: move to the ocean sector adjacent to yours in the direction the vane shows, if there is one. GO TO at the helm
SE, SW, SGO TO holed

if there is one
SE, SW, S

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:a-bone-to-pi.title: A Bone to Pick
ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:a-bone-to-pi.html:
The tomb is cold and dry. The king lies on his bier, a greatsword on his chest, and on his throne sits the thing that has been humming: a tall puppet of mismatched bones, sewn together with sinew. Before it, on a slab, lies a child of the king's blood, humming in her sleep, and its needle fingers are already at work. Any children who reached the door before you stand around the bier, eyes shut, and the dead stand with them. The humming stops when it sees you.

The Court of Bones
Enemy HP: 13 + 8 per player
Enemy
Raised Commander (#10)
Raised Bones (#3)
Civilian (#43)
Additional Rules
  • The Civilian is the child on the slab. If it dies, +1 curse.
  • At 10 or more curse, one more Raised Bones, and enemy HP is 12 + 10 per player; at 20 or more, two more, and 21 per player.
  • Then enemy HP is 3 more per player for each black cube on the Barrow: a child who reached it.
Outcome
Victory
  • The king's greatsword: Oathkeeper (Unique Weapon #4).
  • The king's grave goods: 1x random Rare Armor, 1x random Uncommon Travel item and 4 gold.
  • 6 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the bones fall apart at last, the children wake, and the king sleeps easy, with nothing left to steal. You complete the quest. You finished The Sleepwalkers. Remove the quest's cubes and the bookmark. STOP READING.

If you lost, it lets you crawl back up into the light, and goes back to its sewing. STOP READING.

ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-hill-ope.title: The Hill Opens
ev:aux-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-hill-ope.html: Far off, the humming stops. Every child of the king's blood is awake now, or under the hill. When you next pass the barrow, the slab over its door will be lying open: whatever is inside has finished calling, and is waiting for you. If a rest brought you here, finish your rest. STOP READING.

ev:aux-drunken-mob-trap-chest:opening-a-.html:
You grab the side handles and pull, opening the chest with a satisfying creak.

Spin the weather vane:

STOP READING.

ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:the-fire-wins.title: The Fire Wins
ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:the-fire-wins.html: The wood is a single flame now, and the smoke turns noon to dusk for a hundred miles. Far off in the dunes, the dome glows again: it's growing a new heart. The quest fails. Remove the quest's cubes and the bookmark. STOP READING.

ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:the-heart-of-th.title: The Heart of the Fire
ev:aux-emberskitter-nest:the-heart-of-th.html:
In a crater of ash lies the core, split open and cooling. Beside it, on a slab of fused coins, crouches a spider the size of a wagon, silk running molten from her spinnerets.

Mother of Sparks
Enemy HP: 12 + 11 per player
Enemy
Ember Matriarch (#27)
Emberskitter Sack (#26)

Additional Rules
  • One more Emberskitter for every 10 curse.
  • At 10 or more curse, enemy HP is 12 + 13 per player; at 20 or more, 12 + 14.
Outcome

  • Obliteration Ichor (Unique Potion #2).
  • 1x random Rare item, 1x random Uncommon item and 12 gold.
  • 6 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • +1 curse.
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the fire gutters out, and far off in the dunes, the Nest goes dark. You complete the quest. You finished The Burning Weald. Remove the quest's cubes and the bookmark. STOP READING.

If you lost, the heat drives you back, for now. STOP READING.

ev:aux-greed-eater:a-fair-trade.html: She weighs your offer with great seriousness, then hands the thing over, and skips off home to show her mother. You gain the item. STOP READING.

ev:aux-greed-eater:a-lowball-offer.html:
She looks at your coins for a long moment. Spin the weather vane, and go to:

E, W, SE, SW, Scontinue reading

Her smile freezes, a little too wide. “Greedy, I sssuppose,” says a voice from behind her closed mouth. “Yesss, the massster would approve.” GO TO A Terrible Mistake.

ev:aux-greed-eater:a-perfectly-ordinary-.html: Her wails follow you all the way down the lane, and a farmer comes out of the house with a pitchfork, far too late to catch you. Just a child, then. You almost feel bad about it. STOP READING.

ev:aux-greed-eater:a-terrible-mistake.title: A Terrible Mistake
ev:aux-greed-eater:a-terrible-mistake.html:
The child's skin cracks like dry earth, and something else unfolds out of it: a cloak of charcoal smoke, an ivory mask with slits for eyes, and strings of gold coins that clink as it leans over you. “I take you to the massster now,” it hisses, and draws a golden blade.

Avatar of Greed
Enemy HP: 8 + 7 per player
Enemy
Greed Eater (#28)
Additional Rules
  • If you snatched the item, each player draws 2 fewer cards in the first round.
  • Gold on the Greed Eater's portrait: if you win, each player takes back what it didn't eat; if you lose, the gold is gone.
Outcome
Victory

  • 12 gold.
  • 6 exp for each player.
Defeat

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:aux-greed-eater:shiny-enough.html: She snatches the coins, bites one, and runs off home before you can change your mind. Pay half the item's value in gold, rounded up, and gain the item. STOP READING.

ev:aux-greed-eater:snatched.html:
She gasps, and her face crumples for a tantrum. You gain the item. Spin the weather vane, and go to:

VaneGo to
N, NE, NWGO TO a perfectly ordinary tantrum
E, W, SE, SW, Scontinue reading

The tantrum stops halfway, in a rictus no child could hold. A voice hisses from somewhere beside her: “Greedy... Yesss, as the massster said.” GO TO A Terrible Mistake.

links.clause: N, NE, NW

ev:aux-improvised-vessel-2:shipwrecked.html: The sea spits you out at last, onto sand, shingle or rock, it hardly matters which. Everyone gains 1 curse. The party washes up together on the land location nearest to where it was. If several are equally near, choose one. STOP READING.

If a Fate or Sealed Fate was among the discarded cards, trouble finds you: play it (Sealed Fate, if both were), and read the Oceans section of its page. If not, GO TO another day at sea.

Salt on your lips, and the sea all round.

Choose one
  • Sail on. GO TO a leg at sea.
  • (If your sector has a landing) Come ashore at the landing. GO TO an easy landing.
  • Come ashore wherever your sector touches land. GO TO a rough landing.

The raft breaks up in the shallows, and you wade the rest of the way. Spin the weather vane:

VaneAshore
SE, SW, SNothing but bruises.
NE, NW, E, WA crate from some other wreck has washed up beside yours. You gain 1x random Common Travel item.

Then move to any land location in your sector. GO TO successful landing.

ev:aux-improvised-vessel:improvised-vess.title: Improvised Vessel
ev:aux-improvised-vessel:improvised-vess.html:
A few hours of hard work later, you drag a passable raft to the water's edge and raise a sail stitched from spare canvas. It fills at once, pulling out to sea. Unsure which god to pray to, you push off.

GO TO a leg at sea.

ev:aux-improvised-vessel:successful-land.html:
By the time your feet touch solid ground, you're exhausted, sunburned, but alive. Not like dying is of concern, but once at the safety of the shore you shudder to think of the existence that awaited you at the bottom of the ocean, had this journey gone any differently.

Legs still wobbly and unsteady, you leave the raft behind and carry on.

STOP READING.

ev:aux-pirates:boarding-party.title: Boarding Party
ev:aux-pirates:boarding-party.html:

Bandit (#1)

  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
